8250014.en: The woman touches your forehead, and a jolt of energy shoots up your spine. Knowledge floods your mind, as if the manual's secrets have been whispered directly into your ear.
8250014.ch: 面前灵体朝你额心一点，一股力量自你小腹升起灌顶而上，同时眼前女灵体开始对你口传心授。只眨眼间你似乎领悟了当前秘籍的大部分内容。

8250015.en: Not bad. I did help you a bit, but for a little goofball like you, you're learning fast.
8250015.ch: 虽然说有我帮助，不过你这小笨蛋领悟起来倒也很快。

8250016.en: Maybe I saw something in you and couldn't resist giving you some advice, little goofball. Or maybe... I had my own reasons.
8250016.ch: 也许，姐姐看你这小笨蛋多少有几分机灵，忍不住就来指点两句。又或者，姐姐是有所求而来呢？

8250017.en: But does it matter? You've got the knowledge now.
8250017.ch: 不过，这很重要吗？反正你都已经得了好处了。

8250018.en: Well, well. Seems our little goofball is tight-lipped, too. No matter. Let's talk with our fists. Look.
8250018.ch: 没想到小笨蛋不只是个小笨蛋，还是个闷嘴葫芦。不过没关系。不动嘴，可以动手。你看。

8250019.en: She points, and a cultivator charges, his eyes a burning rage.
8250019.ch: 女灵葱指点向远方，果见一名修士，目露凶光朝你冲来！

8250020.en: Hmph! You caused quite a ruckus while being locked up in "Aether Breath Manual." Very impressive!
8250020.ch: 哼，你这家伙，被封到《玄息全本》之中还能搞出这么多动静，倒叫我刮目相看！

8250021.en: My apologies, but I'm unable to attend to you personally. Instead, you'll be facing this one here.
8250021.ch: 抱歉，我不能亲自招呼你。因此你的对手不是我，是这位。

8250022.en: Hmph! What pathetic weaklings you are! Since you know of the witch, I've got to kill you!
8250022.ch: 哼，哪里蛊惑来的虾兵蟹将！你既知道那妖妇，自也留你不得！

8250023.en: The woman casts a cold glance at your defeated enemy, then approaches him with a malicious smirk.
8250023.ch: 女灵冷冷的看了看被你打败的敌人，然后不怀好意的笑着朝他走了过去。

8250024.en: Well then, let's have a little chat.

8250026.en: A woman in purple robes, with double pupils... Where did she go?
8250026.ch: 女性、紫衣，眼有重瞳，她去哪了？

8250027.en: You think I'd turn my back on the Venerable One? Think again, you wretched witch. Haha!
8250027.ch: 我怎么可能背叛尊者，你太小看人了，妖婆。哈哈。

8250028.en: The cultivator hasn't even finished laughing when his eyes roll back. His body jerks violently, and in a flash, he falls still, lifeless.
8250028.ch: 那名修士笑罢，突然间双眼翻白，全身痉挛，只片刻便没了动静。

8250029.en: Hmph... I knew it, they've had quite a lot of loyal lackeys.
8250029.ch: 哼……果然养了不少忠心的看门狗。

8250030.en: Well, well, little goofball. You managed to put your training to good use in the thick of the fight. Looks like you might have a future after all.
8250030.ch: 小笨蛋，交手之际便即将所学融会贯通，倒也是个可造之材。

8250031.en: Oh, and by the way, my name is <ta1>. Until we meet again. And remember, even without my supervision, you'd better <r>study the manuals</r>. Got it?
8250031.ch: 对了，我叫{name|B}，有缘再见吧。没我监督，也要<r>好好学习秘籍</r>，知道了吗？呵呵。

8250032.en: As the woman speaks her final words, her form dissolves into wisps of ethereal smoke, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
8250032.ch: 这女子说着，身子化为青烟，眨眼消散。

8250033.en: Want to know who I am? Well, that'll cost you.
8250033.ch: 你真想知道？知道我名字是要付出代价的。

8250034.en: Listen up, you little goofball. Help me defeat this man, and I'll tell you my name.
8250034.ch: 小笨蛋，帮我击退这人，姐姐告诉你名字。

8250048.en: First off, I didn't call you a goofball. I called you a little goofball. And let's be real, "little goofball" is pretty cute, right? If I thought someone was a real goof, I wouldn't even bother talking to them. So don't get the wrong idea, okay, you little goofball? Haha.
8250048.ch: 第一，姐姐没叫你笨蛋，我是叫你小笨蛋。第二，姐姐只是觉得小笨蛋听起来好亲切。第三，如果姐姐觉得那个人蠢，我压根就不会搭理。小笨蛋，你可千万不要生出什么误会了，呵呵。

8250049.en: As you open the manual to start your studies, boom! Energy swirls into existence before you, forming a woman.
8250049.ch: 你翻开秘籍正待参研，不了虚空中灵力交汇，现出一个女灵。

8250050.en: Miss me already? Tch, what a piece of junk you've got there.
8250050.ch: 有想姐姐吗？啧，这是什么破烂玩意？

8250051.en: With a playful laugh, {name|B} snatches the manual from your hands, quickly skims through it, and gives an approving nod.
8250051.ch: {name|B}嬉笑着夺过你手中秘籍，匆匆浏览一遍，然后微微颔首。

8250052.en: There might not be anything groundbreaking in this manual, but since you want to learn, I'll give you a few pointers.
8250052.ch: 秘籍之中不见得有许多新奇见解，不过你既然想学，我也就指点一二吧。

8250053.en: Just like before, <ta1> patiently explains everything to you. In no time flat, you've soaked up all the knowledge in the manual.
8250053.ch: 一如此前，{name|B}耐心地给你讲解，只眨眼间你便学会了秘籍的内容。

8250054.en: Well, little goofball, you're a real gem. I'm more than happy to teach you more. But there's a little catch.
8250054.ch: 小笨蛋，也算是块良材美玉，姐姐，倒愿多指点你一下，只可惜，这里面却有个难处。

8250055.en: There's a tough part in this manual that even I can't figure out. But I know about a book called the "Aether Breath Manual" that could crack the case.
8250055.ch: 你这秘籍有个难处我也无法索解，但我知道有《玄息秘本》可以解决这个疑难。

8250056.en: And this manual isn't too far away. Once we get our hands on it and I've gone through it, I should be able to answer a lot of our questions. After that, if you have any other manuals you want me to teach you, it'll be a breeze.
8250056.ch: 而且此秘本就被藏在不远处。一旦取得秘本，我通读之后，当能解决很多疑问，到时你再有什么秘籍想要我指点，那就容易多了。

8250057.en: <ta1> points towards the northeast. Through the foggy mess, you can make out some rooftops poking out. There must be a hidden place deep in the mountains.
8250057.ch: {name|B}抬手指点东北角，只见远方雾霭苍茫处，透出一角飞檐。想必深山之中，藏有建筑。

8250058.en: You go inside the place, and it's completely empty. In the inner room, on an altar, is a golden chest. When you take a closer look, you see it's quite extravagant—not just any box.
8250058.ch: 你来到建筑之中，但内里空无一人，只见内室供案上放着一方金匮，观之精致华美，非同凡品。

8250059.en: You pop open the golden chest to find an ancient book inside—the Aether Breath Manual. It is wrapped up in an oilcloth, like a real treasure. Just as you're about to take a closer look, an owl screeches in the air, echoing through the wild...
8250059.ch: 你开启金匮，里面平放一部《玄息秘本》的古朴典籍。这本秘籍由油布包裹，可见是珍藏之物。你还待细看，不想远方发出枭叫，声彻四野……

8250060.en: Don't get sidetracked now. Some lackeys are coming your way. Be on your guard.
8250060.ch: 不要分心，看门的狗腿子来了，小心。

8250061.en: Who's that? What business do you have here?
8250061.ch: 阁下何人？如何无故闯入？

8250062.en: Capture the intruder first! We'll ask questions later!

8250063.en: Capture? Nonsense! This thief came for the golden chest. Kill them on sight!
8250063.ch: 还拿下？此人冲着金匮而来，直接杀了即可。

8250064.en: You manage to hold off the first wave of attacking cultivators. Suddenly, another owl hoots, and a scary monster appears before you. In the distance, you can hear more and more cultivators rushing towards you.
8250064.ch: 你赶开第一批来攻的修士，不想远方发出一声枭叫，一只妖兽来到你的面前，远处声势大起，似另有修士正往这边赶来。

8250065.en: Don't worry about the reinforcements. Remember, cut off the head and the body will fall. Focus on killing the monster king.
8250065.ch: 来援修士络绎不绝，不必在意。擒贼擒王，专心击杀眼前妖王便是。

8250066.en: Don't waste time fighting with the reinforcements. The Aether Breath Manual is super valuable—just take it and run. Follow my lead exactly, and we'll get out of here without a scratch.
8250066.ch: 不要再和来援的人多作纠缠，《玄息秘本》珍贵异常，取走即可。听我指引行事，当可安然离去。

8250067.en: Following {name|B}'s directions, you weave a crazy path through the area, losing your pursuers in no time. Just as you stop to catch your breath in the wild, a figure steps out of the shadows.
8250067.ch: 你依着{name|B}指点，东一拐，西一转的，果然很快就摆脱来人的追踪。你待在荒野之中正欲稍作喘息，然而林荫深处一人闲步踱出。

8250068.en: Huh, seems this mutt has a better nose than I thought, tracking us down all the way here. Take him down!
8250068.ch: 狗鼻子倒灵，跟着追到这边来了。打倒他！

8250069.en: Fellow cultivator, surely you were tricked by this witch before you. That's why you broke into our temple and stole the manual, right?
8250069.ch: 道友想必也是受了眼前这妖妇唆摆，这才潜入我观，盗走秘本。

8250070.en: Fellow cultivator, do you really know what this seductive creature is? She's neither human nor ghost. If you're curious, I can tell you all about her. Why resort to violence? Just give back the Aether Breath Manual, and everything will be okay.
8250070.ch: 道友，你知道眼前这个美女是个什么东西吗？她可是个人不人，鬼不鬼的东西呢。你想知道，我一一告诉你，我们何必动手动脚的呢？你只需把《玄息》交还就可以了。

8250071.en: Ah... Ah... What is this... Ah! Purple Mist! Purple Mist!
8250071.ch: 啊……啊……这是什么……啊！紫罗烟！紫罗烟！

8250072.en: Suddenly, flames engulf the man before you. He flails around frantically, but the fire burns with supernatural speed. In the blink of an eye, it's over. The wind blows away the tiny ashes left on the ground, leaving no trace.
8250072.ch: 眼前之人突然全身腾起火焰，扑来扑去。但火焰燃烧极快，只眨眼间便熄灭了，地上仅余的灰烬经风一吹，四散飘扬，分毫不留。

8250073.en: Hmph, you think losing my body means I can't touch you? Heh, ironically, this was your own Venerable One's treasure. I guess you could say you died for a good cause.
8250073.ch: 哼，以为我没了身体便治不得你们么。呵，说起来这可是你们尊者的秘宝呢，眼下你们也算是死得其所了。

8250074.en: Me? Explain myself? If anything, you owe me a thank you. So, thanks a lot, little goofball.
8250074.ch: 我需要交代什么？我需要的是道谢吧？多谢你呢，小笨蛋。

8250075.en: Now that we've got our hands on this manual, I can really dig into it. From now on, I'll be able to whip out answers and solutions to any of your problems.
8250075.ch: 找到秘本，我就能好好研读，以后你有什么疑难我都能顺利解答了。

8250076.en: I mean, have you ever seen a human more gorgeous than me, or a ghost more enchanting? So, "neither human nor ghost" is pretty spot-on, I'd say.
8250076.ch: 我反正没见过比我美丽的人，也没见过比我娇艳的鬼。如此看来，“人不人，鬼不鬼”这话倒也算得中肯。

8250077.en: I don't get it entirely either, but it seems to be a treasure from their sect. It's powered by geomancy, and when you flip certain dynamics, it goes up in flames. The fire's mixed with Nether Air, making it one of the nastiest treasures out there.
8250077.ch: 姐姐也不太明白，不过好像这是他们门中的一个秘宝，受堪舆之术控制，一旦某些关键被逆转，即燃烧起来。当中火焰参杂冥气，乃是最为恶毒的秘宝。

8250078.en: Oh, you little goofball. Remember, if you know yourself and your enemy, you'll win every fight.
8250078.ch: 真是个小笨蛋，知己知彼，方可百战百胜啊。

8250079.en: Heaven knows I don't get all the details myself. But one thing's clear: they definitely have an agenda. To be honest, I'm pretty curious about these hidden secrets too.
8250079.ch: 天地良心，我也不大搞得明白。不过可以肯定的是，他们肯定有所图谋。其实，姐姐也很想搞明白这中间的隐秘。

8250080.en: This manual is the most precious thing in the world. Mastering it lets you breathe like the universe itself, separating the pure from the impure, and cleaning up all the dirt. It's the most amazing and essential manual under the sun.
8250080.ch: 这秘本么，倒是天下间第一等珍贵的秘籍，习之可效天地大化之吞吐，扬清激浊，排除污秽，乃是天下第一等神妙的秘籍总要。

8250081.en: Sadly, times have changed. I doubt today's cultivators care much for these manuals, huh?
8250081.ch: 不过可惜，时移世易，如今的修仙者已经看不起这等秘籍了吧？

8250082.en: Humph! These crooks, with their shady plans, have not only hidden the manual but also used some weird magic to link this rare copy to monsters. When the Aether Breath is left alone, the monsters sleep. But if someone messes with the manual, the monsters wake up instantly to block any intruders.
8250082.ch: 哼，这伙人居心叵测暗藏秘籍，还以异法将此孤本与妖兽联系起来。《玄息》无碍，则妖兽沉睡，秘本但有异动，妖兽立即觉醒，阻碍来人。

8250083.en: These crooks are working with the monsters. We'll come back another day to teach them a lesson.
8250083.ch: 这伙人与妖兽沆瀣一气，我们改天再来惩戒。

8250084.en: All I saw was you bravely facing powerful enemies and finding a way out gracefully. Was that even a risk? You had plenty of energy left.
8250084.ch: 我只看见你勇拒强敌，在众人之中从容退出，这也算是风险吗？这是行有余力。

8250085.en: Oh, you little goofball, thanks for your help. Now that you have the manual, I'm going to hide inside its pages from now on. I need to study it carefully. To repay you, I'll try to guide you if you decide to learn from the manual.
8250085.ch: 小笨蛋，多谢你助我，你带着秘本，从今而后，我于秘本之中藏身。我需细细遍读全书。为了报答你，你若学习秘籍的话，我会尝试指点你的。

8250086.en: As you start to study the manual, a figure suddenly appears from its pages.
8250086.ch: 你学习秘籍之际，只见里面灵体突然出现。

8250087.en: This manual isn't difficult to grasp, but it's not exactly easy to understand at first either. Let me help you out.
8250087.ch: 这本秘籍内容不算深奥，但初看之下，倒也不易理解。我帮一下你吧。

8250088.en: As <ta1> starts to teach you, you try to do the martial arts. Suddenly, the energy inside you gets out of balance. Above, the sky explodes with flashes of lightning and loud thunder. Tons of bolts hit the ground around you, sending pieces of stone flying everywhere.
8250088.ch: {name|B}开始指点于你，就在你试着运使功法之际，体内灵力开始失衡，同时头顶电闪雷鸣，无数霹雳开始落在你身边，打得周围碎石纷飞。

8250089.en: Oh, you little goofball. I forgot to mention, such an aggressive approach often triggers a trial. See? You've just triggered one.
8250089.ch: 小笨蛋，忘了跟你说，这般激进，多半会招来天劫，呵呵。这不，就触发天劫了。

8250090.en: You come out of the trial without a scratch and start to calm down your chaotic internal energy. But then you notice <ta1> smiling while looking past you. You follow the gaze and see several cultivators standing around you silently.
8250090.ch: 你安然度过天劫，正在稳定体内紊乱的灵力。却见身边{name|B}微笑看着你的身后，你循其目光看去，只见几名修士已无声无息的围住了你。

8250091.en: Humph, I knew you were behind this mess. I never thought you could cause so much chaos while stuck in the book. You used this person to try and break free, didn't you? Is this the one?
8250091.ch: 哼，我早知是你这家伙捣鬼。没想到受困书中还能弄出这么大的乱子。你是借旁人之手为你脱困吧？就是这人？

8250092.en: Let's kill this one first and deal with the rest later. Only one of the three seals is broken; this witch is still far from free.
8250092.ch: 先杀了再说，禁制不过三去其一，这妖妇仍未脱困。

8250093.en: And who do you think you are, acting like you're in charge of everything?

8250095.en: He's calming down his internal energy. What now? Planning to silence him for good? Right now, he's too busy to care about anything else—blind to your actions, deaf to your words. If you have any problems, take them out on me instead.
8250095.ch: 稳定体内灵力。怎么？要杀人灭口？眼下此人自顾不暇，目不能视，耳不能听，不知道你们在干什么。有什么尽管冲我来。

8250096.en: No need to hurry. We'll get you back first. Ending his life? That'll be a piece of cake.
8250096.ch: 不急，先拿你回去，再要了此人的命，也不过举手之劳罢了。

8250097.en: Suddenly, thorny vines burst forth from the ground. Caught off guard by this unexpected turn, the two cultivators find themselves ensnared.
8250097.ch: 突然间荆牙破土而出，那二人未料有此变数，顿被紧紧缠住。

8250098.en: You know, these are actually the secret techniques of your Venerable One. I've always been loath to use them, but given my current predicament—trapped in this book as I am—I suppose I have no choice but to borrow your methods.
8250098.ch: 说起来，这些都是你们那位前辈“尊者”的秘术呢。我原本不屑使用，不过眼下我受困书中，说不得，也只能借用一下你们家的手段了。

8250099.en: So, where's your precious purple-robed Venerable One?
8250099.ch: 好了，给我说说，你们的紫衣尊者在哪？

8250100.en: Tsk, I know who you are. Our records warn us about you. You're just a defeated enemy of the Venerable One. What do you think you're going to do now?
8250100.ch: 哼，我知道你，书楼中留有记载，要千万提防你重新出世。尊者的手下败将，你现在是要怎么样？

8250101.en: What else does she want? Obviously, she's trying to get back at the Venerable One. Even if we knew something, why would we tell you? Argh...
8250101.ch: 她还能怎样？不消说，那自是找尊者报仇了。别说我们不知道，就算知道又怎会告诉你？呃……！

8250102.en: These thorns are deadly. One prick and you're done. Want to try it?
8250102.ch: 哼，荆牙之中的剧毒还真厉害，这么刺了一下就完了，你怎么说？也想尝尝这滋味？

8250103.en: What do you want exactly? And what does your Venerable One want?
8250103.ch: 你们究竟想做什么？你们的“尊者”又想做什么？

8250104.en: You'll get nothing out of me! Argh!

8250105.en: Hmph, who is this purple-robed woman? After all this time, she still has her followers willing to die for her.
8250105.ch: 哼，这紫衣女什么来头，过去这般长的时间了，还能让她的徒子徒孙们为她送死。

8250106.en: Alright, you little goofball. If you're going to pretend to be asleep, at least snore. Anyone can see through your act.
8250106.ch: 好了，小笨蛋，装睡要记得打呼噜，不然旁人还是能一眼就看出来的。

8250107.en: My purpose? I was protecting you! Those two were going to attack you.
8250107.ch: 目的，我刚不是在给你护法吗？正如你听到的那样，这两人不安好心，要对你出手呢。

8250108.en: I'm just a poor soul who got set up. I'm using you to escape. Surely you wouldn't let me suffer for good?
8250108.ch: 我是个受人暗算的弱女子，就算是要借你之手脱困，又怎么了？难道你又忍心让我一直受苦受难？

8250109.en: What's the matter? Feeling used? Well, let me spare you the trouble.
8250109.ch: 怎么？觉得被利用了？也罢，省得你在那瞎想。

8250110.en: Look, I'm trapped in this book, with nothing but a vestige of breath. My only goal is to break free.
8250110.ch: 我老实与你说，我被人困于书中，眼下仅余一点元魂支持。我的目的就是摆脱受困的现状。

8250111.en: And what's keeping me prisoner? That Aether Breath Manual you're holding. I need someone's help, and I'm hoping it's you.
8250111.ch: 而困住姐姐的，就是你手中的《玄息秘本》。如今，我还需旁人帮助才能成功脱困，你就来帮一下我这弱女子吧？

8250112.en: Long story short, a shady woman in purple robes tried to pull a fast one a long long time ago.
8250112.ch: 哼，说来话长，我也只好长话短说。估计那是很久很久以前了。我察觉一名神秘紫衣女子颇怀异心，似乎在进行什么重大图谋。

8250113.en: She caught me snooping around and trapped me in this book. Inside, I learned a trick to jump between other manuals, which is how you found me.
8250113.ch: 可惜，就在我查探她的过程中被她发现，最后她使诡计将我囚于书中。我在里面悟得妙法穿行出没于其他秘籍之中，直到你找到了我。

8250114.en: Now, I just want out. I want to shed my shackles.
8250114.ch: 如今我一心脱困，便是要摆脱身上这层“枷锁”罢了。

8250115.en: Okay, I need to think this through. When I have a plan, I'll need your help. In the meantime, you little goofball, focus on your cultivation.
8250115.ch: 很好，眼下我仍需要沉思，待我有眉目了，自会请你相助。小笨蛋，趁着这些时日赶紧认真修炼吧。

8250116.en: With a puff of smoke, <ta1> vanishes back into the Aether Breath Manual you're holding.
8250116.ch: {name|B}只一转身便即化为一缕烟气重回你手中《玄息秘本》之中。

8250117.en: Fine, be that way. I'm still bound, and those shady people will eventually come for me again. Lock me away in another manual, under heavy guard. If you want it that way, just leave me here.
8250117.ch: 呵，那也由得你。我身上束缚未去，那些神秘人早晚会将我收回到别的秘籍之中严加看管。你若忍心，不妨将我晾在那儿。

8250118.en: Hey, have you heard? That book monster that was causing trouble got caught and taken to the Manual Pavilion.
8250118.ch: 兄弟，你听说过了吗？日前肆虐的书妖被抓到上缴到琅琊阁了。

8250119.en: Yeah, I heard. They say it didn't end well. The Manual Pavilion got their hands on the manual and burned it.
8250119.ch: 听说了，听说那书妖怪可怜的。琅琊阁得了那本秘籍，当众就烧了。

8250120.en: I heard that book monster was a stunner. Is that true?
8250120.ch: 我听说那书妖，长得很好看？

8250121.en: Who cares? It used to look like a dried-up raisin. It only got pretty after sucking the life force out of cultivators.
8250121.ch: 好看又怎样？那书树本来是一个人干的模样，那时吸了修士的阴元才变得好看的。

8250122.en: Geez, this world is getting weirder by the day. Now we have monsters that prey on cultivators' life energy.
8250122.ch: 唉，这八荒真是越来越奇怪了，专门吸修士阴元的妖怪都有了。

8250123.en: Exactly. These are dark times. It's good Master of the Pavilion is keeping things in check.
8250123.ch: 嗯，就是啊，不太平，幸好琅琊阁主持公道了。

8250124.en: The two of them walk away, chatting, and soon disappear from sight.
8250124.ch: 那两人边说边走，眨眼间就去得远了。

8250125.en: Well, well, look at the little goofball go-getter, always thinking about cultivation. Let me give you some tips.
8250125.ch: 小笨蛋倒也上进，总是惦记着修炼。我来指点一二吧。

8250126.en: I found the second seal. Why don't you go check it out? It's not far from here. Let's go take a look.
8250126.ch: 而我也找到第二道封印的地方，你替我踩下点如何？就在不远处，你带我去一趟吧。

8250127.en: You arrive at an old, abandoned temple. Weeds are everywhere, and crows are cawing loudly. It's clearly been empty for a long time.
8250127.ch: 你来到一处荒凉的道观之中，周围杂草丛生，栖鸦乱叫，一看而知乃是个废弃已久的地方。

8250128.en: As you step into the ruined temple, a bunch of little monsters surround you. They have a dark, evil Nether Air, and it's clear they're not friendly.
8250128.ch: 你走进荒观后，周围突然出现若干小妖围住了你。这些妖物一个个透着冥气，一看而知，绝非善类。

8250129.en: What's that in your hand? Is that the Venerable One's artifact?
8250129.ch: 你手上拿的是什么？是尊者的法器！

8250130.en: Tsk, it is. It was made by the Venerable One herself. Too bad it's in my hands now.
8250130.ch: 哼，是啊，说起来这还是你们尊者亲手制造的。不过可惜，如今却落到我手中了。

8250131.en: You shameless thief! Put down that fan!

8250132.en: I'll keep this fan safe. One day, I'll find your Venerable One and give her a taste of her own medicine. I'll cast spells and scorch her face, striking her down without mercy!
8250132.ch: 这折扇我会好好保管，有朝一日，我就要找到你们尊者，用这扇子狠狠地教训她，用这扇子施法，将她的脸打烂，烧烂！

8250133.en: As <ta1> speaks, <ta1> taps the fan on the cultivator's forehead. Without a sound, his head flops to the side, and he falls to the ground.
8250133.ch: {name|B}说着用折扇轻轻一点，正中那修士额心，那人哼也没一声，歪着头便倒下了。

8250134.en: Let's go. I destroyed the seal.

8250135.en: This is the perfect chance to try out those new techniques you learned. After all, defeating demons is what cultivators are for, right? Haha.
8250135.ch: 这不正好给你新学乍练的秘术练练手吗？斩妖除魔也是你的本分吧？呵呵。

8250136.en: I talked to some of my old friend's disciples. Too bad they didn't want to hang out with an old lady like me.
8250136.ch: 我跟故人的徒子徒孙聊了一会。可惜这些家伙好像不太爱陪我这老太婆说话解闷。

8250137.en: I guess they were scared of my powers. They were worried I might break free and destroy their seals. Hiring cultivators as guards would be a waste and might leak secrets. These demon-possessed beasts are the perfect choice.
8250137.ch: 大概是防着我神通广大，有朝一日自行破困来到此处，毁坏禁制吧？请一堆修士看守，不但浪费人力物力，还保不定泄露机密。找这些着了魔的畜牲就最适合了。

8250138.en: Let's go, righteous cultivator. You've killed a lot of monsters for the world today, haven't you? Haha.
8250138.ch: 走吧，正义的修士，今天又为八荒斩杀不少妖物呢，姐姐奖励你一下，这是姐姐以前全盛时期的得意之技，好好钻研一番吧，先走了。

8250139.en: As you open the manual to start your studies, boom! Streams of Qi flow through the pages. At the same time, <ta1> appears in front of you.
8250139.ch: 你打开秘籍进行参悟，书中灵气交缠，{name|B}同时现身。

8250140.en: Silly one, you'll pick this up in no time with my guidance. But this stuff isn't worth dwelling on. Come on, I know a place with something much better.
8250140.ch: 小笨蛋，我指点你一下，一下就学会了。不过这些糟粕不值得深究。走，跟姐姐去个地方，那儿有好东西。

8250141.en: This building might look empty, little goofball, but it might not be so peaceful inside. Do you dare to go in?
8250141.ch: 小笨蛋，眼前这座小楼虽已荒废，但里面却未必太平，你敢不敢进去？

8250142.ch: 一切还需小心谨慎，走吧。

8250143.en: From the outside, this little building looks old and boring. But when you go inside, you're surprised to find it's well-kept. There are rows of beautiful bookshelves, filled with old books and rare manuals. It's a huge library.
8250143.ch: 这小楼从外面看时凋敝衰败，毫不起眼，没料到进入里面，却被人维护得十分好，放眼所及尽是一个个精致的书架，上面有些整齐地放置着陈年书架，有些有序地排着无数珍本秘籍，一看而知，乃是个大型书库。

8250144.en: Suddenly, Qi bursts out of the Aether Breath Manual, and <ta1> appears in an instant. She looks around coldly and starts walking through the library, touching scrolls and books. You hear a click, like something has been activated. A flash of light surrounds <ta1>, and then it's gone. She now has a smile on her face.
8250144.ch: 此时玄息秘本之中的灵气突然泄出，{name|B}瞬间现身，她冷冷的环顾一周，然后漫步书库，这里挪一下竹简，那边抽一下书籍，你听得似乎触动了什么机关，发出喀的一声响，同时{name|B}身上光芒一闪旋即恢复原样。她原本冷冷的面容中透出一丝笑意。

8250145.en: Hmph, always with these tricks. You've kept me locked up for too long. Today, I'm going to burn down your precious library!
8250145.ch: 哼，就爱搞这些神神秘秘的玩意，你困我多时，今日就把你们的书库一把烧了！

8250146.en: With a wave of <ta1>'s hand, she pulls the Aether Breath Manual out of your bag. Without even looking at it, she throws it into the air. Flames burst out of the manual, setting fire to the scrolls and books around it. By the time the manual hits the ground, the whole library is on fire.
8250146.ch: {name|B}素手一招，你身上《玄息秘本》突然从你囊中跃出飞入她手中。她看也不看，抬手就将秘籍丢出。那《玄息秘本》在空中窜起火苗，过处点燃竹简书籍，到其落地时，偌大书库已成一片火海。

8250147.en: Suddenly, a bunch of cultivators burst in from outside, surrounding you and <ta1>.
8250147.ch: 变起俄顷，数名修士从外闯入，围住了{name|B}与你。

8250148.en: She... she broke the seal in the library...
8250148.ch: 她……她解开了书库中的封印……

8250149.en: Yeah, and I also set your library on fire.
8250149.ch: 是啊，我还顺便放了把火，把你们的书库烧了。

8250150.en: This is outrageous! Grab her and lock her up again!
8250150.ch: 岂有此理，把她抓回去重新关起来！

8250151.en: Now that I'm free, I'm like a fish in water, a bird flying in the sky. You're just living off your master's glory. Trying to cage me is a joke.
8250151.ch: 今日得脱，正是鱼入大海，鸟上青霄。你们这群虾兵蟹将不过仗着你们祖师爷的遗法狐假虎威，想要留我，那是痴人说梦。

8250152.en: As everyone tries to grab her, she turns to look at you. You see a tiny smile on <ta1>'s face before she disappears among the bookshelves. It's like magic. She's gone in a flash, and the cultivators can't catch her...
8250152.ch: 众人要去拿她，未料她不看众人，反朝你看来。只见{name|B}隐约露出一个不易察觉的微笑，这才转身在那些书柜之中漫步穿行。说来神奇，她左一拐，右一转，只眨眼间便撇开了四处堵截的修士失去了踪影……

8250153.en: That guy must be her partner. Grab him! We'll make him tell us where she went.
8250153.ch: 这人是她的帮手，将他拿了，再逼问妖妇下落。

8250154.en: I didn't expect her partner to be so strong... Haha... But you've been fooled too, haven't you? That woman is an evil cultivator that our master had a hard time trapping. You naive fool...
8250154.ch: 没想到妖妇的援手这么强……呵呵呵……不过你也被蒙在鼓里了吧？她可是我们祖师费劲千辛万苦才困住的邪修，你这懵懂的家伙……

8250155.en: Ha! She was using you. As soon as you entered this pavilion, you triggered a spell. Now you're trapped in a terrible destiny you can't escape.
8250155.ch: 呵，左右那妖妇不过是利用你罢了，自打你进这阁楼已触动了阁楼中的异术，自此你都被骇人的气运纠缠，生生世世，不得解开。

8250156.en: He stops talking. The burning library collapses with a loud crash, sending a cloud of smoke, dust, and flames into the sky...
8250156.ch: 这人说完便没了动静，就在同时书库阁楼在烈火焚烧下，结构已然破损，但听轰隆一声，猛然崩塌，烟尘挟着火光冲上半天，良久不散……

8250157.en: Well, well! Those wimps couldn't touch you, could they? Here, take this manual. I found it in the library.
8250157.ch: 呦，那些个虾兵蟹将果然奈何你不得。这是姐姐从书库里找到的秘籍，你拿着。

8250158.en: <ta1>'s face shows a bit of sadness, but she quickly hides it with a smile. She picks up the manual.
8250158.ch: {name|B}脸上隐约露出难过的神情，但她随即以微笑掩饰过了，然后弯腰默默地从地上捡回秘籍。

8250159.en: Oh? I'm an evil cultivator, huh? So what?

8250160.en: Excellent! I love people who go against the grain.
8250160.ch: 很好，姐姐就喜欢你这种拧巴的家伙。

8250161.en: Hey, if you're doing me a solid, I can't let you go without a little reward, can I?
8250161.ch: 呵，你替姐姐办事，好处又怎会少了你的？

8250162.en: Now, now, don't get all worked up. Your manuals are a bit subpar, and I'm just helping you out by finding better ones. How can you call that exploitation?
8250162.ch: 你这话就说得严重了。你的秘籍太差，姐姐给你找好的，怎么就是在利用你了呢？

8250163.en: I don't see the problem. You get awesome manuals, and I get my freedom. It's a win-win. Or maybe you'd rather see me stuck in there?
8250163.ch: 这姐姐就不明白了，既能为你拿到好秘籍，又可帮我脱困，此事一石二鸟，何乐而不为？还是说你乐意姐姐被困着？

8250164.en: No need to thank me. You've been a lifesaver, and I'm really grateful. I'll make it up to you, I promise.
8250164.ch: 道谢倒不必，你助我良多，姐姐打心底感激你呢！日后总会想法子报答你的，呵呵。

8250165.en: Well, this is a surprise. Come here, let me make you feel better.
8250165.ch: 这个倒是始料不及，来，姐姐给安慰一下。

8250166.en: With a playful smirk, <ta1> reaches out to touch your face...
8250166.ch: {name|B}一脸嬉笑，伸手朝你脸上摸来……

8250167.en: You swat <ta1>'s hand away. She looks at the reddened spot, but instead of getting mad, she just gives you a soft smile.
8250167.ch: 你一把打开{name|B}的手，她看了看自己通红的手背，也不生气，只是朝你微微笑了笑。

8250168.en: <ta1> gently strokes your cheek, her eyes filled with a strange tenderness. The scent of her delicate hand fills the air, creating a moment of intense closeness. But just as things are getting really intimate, her caressing fingers suddenly pinch your cheek hard...
8250168.ch: {name|B}用手缓缓的触着你的脸颊来回轻抚，她看着你的眼中透出一丝与其往日神情不符的温柔，同时，其素手馨香传来，一时间气氛已暧昧到极致。然而就在此时，抚摸你脸颊的手，食指拇指一收，竟狠狠地掐了你一下……

8250169.en: Ha! You little goofball! You're so cute! I want to cuddle you and tease you at the same time!
8250169.ch: 哈哈，小笨蛋这么可爱，真让人又怜又爱！

8250170.en: It's for your own good. I just got out of there and I'm still recovering. If I stayed, I'd only be a drag.
8250170.ch: 那是为你好，姐姐身体才刚脱困，仍未恢复，硬是留下，只会成为你的负累。

8250171.en: Leaving so soon? I got these manuals from the library. I marked the tricky parts and wrote down all my notes. You should be able to breeze through them.
8250171.ch: 这就走了？这几本秘籍，乃是从书库之中取得的。我已详细标记难处，也将我的心得悉数写下，你从中学习当能轻松领悟秘籍全部心得。

8250172.en: No worries. The temple isn't going anywhere. We can come back when we're ready.
8250172.ch: 无妨，荒观没长腿，跑不了，咱们大可准备好再来。

8250173.en: Hey, little goofball, have you been working hard lately? I have a plan to help you break free from your destiny.
8250173.ch: 小笨蛋，最近有在好好努力修炼吗？姐姐想到一个法子，可以帮你解除加在身上的气运。

8250174.en: Here's an idea: go to the Manual Pavilion and buy two manuals for me. After I study them, I might be able to figure out how to lift your curse.
8250174.ch: 这样吧，你替我去琅琊阁中买两部秘籍，我研读后或能想到办法解除你的厄运。

8250175.en: As you walk into the Manual Pavilion, a ton of manuals stare back at you. The manager catches your eye and smiles, then tells one of the workers to help you. The worker nods and quickly heads off.
8250175.ch: 你才进入琅琊阁中，琳琅满目的秘籍映入眼帘，其管事与你对视一眼，报以微笑，随即吩咐身边帮手，那人听了管事的吩咐点了点头，迅速去了。

8250176.en: Oh? You got them already? Haha, but I don't need them anymore.
8250176.ch: 这么快就买到了？哈哈，可是我已经不需要了。

8250177.en: <ta1> raises her dainty hand and taps the fan between your collarbones. A burst of energy flows into you. Slowly, the tangled breath that was holding you back starts to fade away.
8250177.ch: {name|B}素手举高，用手中折扇朝你锁骨之间轻轻一点，一股气流鱼贯而入，那原本在你体内纠缠的气息逐渐散去。

8250178.en: The geomancy from before is gone now. Here are two more manuals. I already made notes on them.
8250178.ch: 上回堪舆之术的影响已解除了。这里还有两本秘籍，你一并拿去吧，我已做过记录。

8250179.en: Well, it depends on what you mean by "escape." I'm back in my body and not stuck in the book anymore. But I'm just a woman, and those people are probably still watching me. Getting rid of this whole problem won't be easy.
8250179.ch: 那要看你怎么定义脱困。如今我已经还原了自己的身体，确是没再困在书中了。但姐姐一介弱女，肯定是给那些人盯着的，要彻底解决这个隐患可不简单呢。

8250180.en: I have an agenda. I'm using you for this and that, and even tricking you into helping me fix your curse. That's my evil plan, right?
8250180.ch: 我心怀不轨，利用你做这做那，还利用你帮着我替你解除身上的厄运。这算是我的图谋吧？

8250181.en: Ha, you little goofball. I have high hopes for you, you know. Keep working hard!
8250181.ch: 呵呵，小笨蛋，我看好你噢，记得要努力修炼啊。

8250182.en: As you walk down the path, you can't shake the feeling that someone's watching you. Suddenly, two people step in front of you, blocking your way.
8250182.ch: 你走在路上，但觉得身后始终有人窥探，就在此时，面前两人突然闪出，拦住了你的去路。

8250184.en: This isn't a good place for this. Let's take him somewhere else to grill him.
8250184.ch: 此处不方便行事，将他带走，再来询问。

8250185.en: This guy is tougher than we thought! Let's go!

8250186.en: You manage to fight off the two attackers. As they run away, you see a figure darting through the shadows. Even though it disappears quickly, you can't shake the feeling that it was <ta1>...
8250186.ch: 你将二人击退，但觉幽暗处人影闪动，已然远去，而你依稀感觉那是{name|B}……

8250187.en: It took a lot to get you here. Now, what are you up to?
8250187.ch: 把你们引来还真是废了点功夫，你们究竟在做什么？

8250188.en: Hmph. You sent your little errand boy to the Manual Pavilion to buy specific books, getting our attention.
8250188.ch: 哼，你让那跑腿的去琅琊阁买指定的书，引起我们的注意……

8250189.en: Well, well. I do like a clever person. Now, be honest with me, and I might make things easier for you.
8250189.ch: 很好，我最喜欢聪明人，老实招来，我给你个好下场。

8250191.en: At the very least, I can give you a quick death.

8250192.en: Pah! You're an enemy of the Venerable One, our enemy! A plague on the world! We'll fight you to the death! Aaah!
8250192.ch: 呸，你是尊者的敌人，是我们的敌人！是贻害八荒的祸害！我们誓死不从！呃啊！

8250193.en: Every single one of them is fearless... Lou Ye, you sure know how to bewitch people, don't you?
8250193.ch: 每个都是悍不畏死的家伙……娄夜，你可真会蛊惑人心啊。

8250194.en: Hey, little goofball. I have a new place. Want to join me for a drink to celebrate? I'll be waiting for you.
8250194.ch: 小笨蛋，姐姐新居落成，你来不来喝一盅入伙酒？我等你噢。

8250195.en: <ta1> comes in a hurry, smiling as she tells you the news. Then, her face gets serious for a second as she quickly looks around. After that, she gives you a soft smile and leaves without saying anything else.
8250195.ch: {name|B}匆匆而来，笑着说过这话后，眼神微一肃然，似乎扫视了一下周围。之后，她朝你微微一笑，然后转身离去，再无别话。

8250196.en: You get to the place <ta1> told you about. There's a little house made of green bamboo standing in front of you. Inside, the simple room has only a bed and a desk. Bookshelves line the walls, filled with books and scrolls. The air smells like a mix of the woman's scent and the earthy smell of books and ink.
8250196.ch: 你来到{name|B}所说的地点，只见这边青竹为庐，内室只置一榻一案，墙边都是书柜，上面整齐排列书籍竹简，四下里还微微泛着一股书墨之气。

8250197.en: So? What do you think of my new place? It's pretty special, right?
8250197.ch: 如何？姐姐的新居还算别致吗？

8250198.en: Haha, I couldn't show myself, so I had to send you. Who would've thought those people would still notice you and follow you around?
8250198.ch: 呵呵，姐姐不好露面，只好请你代为走一遭。没想到那伙人还是察觉了，暗中跟住了你。

8250199.en: You're so smart, my little goofball. Even though they followed you, I was watching, ready to warn you if anything bad happened. But with how good you are at fighting off bad guys, I guess you didn't need my help much, did you?
8250199.ch: 小笨蛋果然是天底下最聪明伶俐的人。他们虽然跟着你，但我却没有放松警惕，他们但有异动，我便会出声示警。不过小笨蛋本事大，能够从容退敌，难道还用的着我吗？

8250200.en: Hehe, like they say, a mountain isn't famous because of its height, but because of the gods who live there. With such a wonderful guest at my place, it's shining brighter than ever.
8250200.ch: 呵呵，山不在高，有仙则名。姐姐的漏室有高人莅临，当然是蓬荜生辉了。

8250201.en: How could I have hidden something from you? I invited you here to tell you the whole story. I just hope you can understand how tough my situation is.
8250201.ch: 姐姐岂敢有目的？邀你来此，却是想将一切前因后果合盘拖出，盼你能体谅我的无奈。

8250202.en: Stuck in the book, I have to be careful all the time. Think about it: not only am I in danger, but the whole world could be in trouble too. If I trusted the wrong person, things could get really bad.
8250202.ch: 姐姐受困书中，处处制肘，不得不万分小心。你想，此事不单是我的个人安危，也关乎八荒前途，若是所托非人，那可罪过不小。

8250203.en: I have kept a lot of secrets from you. I hope you can understand why I did it.
8250203.ch: 姐姐几番隐瞒，这中间的苦心还盼你能体谅。

8250204.en: A while back, I found a mysterious master cultivator doing shady things. After looking into it, I finally confronted her. Even though I tried to talk her out of it, she turned on me, called me an enemy, and put me in this book.
8250204.ch: 姐姐昔日发现八荒有神秘大能似乎暗中在行什么诡异之事。我明查暗访，终于见着本人，一番苦劝下，那大能反将我当作敌人，更以书为牢将我困住。

8250205.en: After thinking really hard, I figured out how to get out of the Aether Breath Manual and go into other manuals. Luckily, someone finally noticed me and found me.
8250205.ch: 我穷思极虑，这才想到了从玄息秘本潜入其他秘籍之中的办法，天可怜见，终于有人发现了，并找到了我。

8250206.en: To be honest, inside the Aether Breath Manual, there was no time or space—just nothing. When I got out, I was shocked to see that this world was completely different, not even recognizable.
8250206.ch: 老实说，《玄息秘本》之中无时间空间，只有一片混沌，此番出世，我才知道八荒已然沧海桑田，发生了翻天覆地的变化。

8250207.en: That master cultivator told her followers to watch out for me and be ready for me to come back and get revenge. She had a backup plan. To get away from her followers, I had to get rid of the mark he put on me.
8250207.ch: 那位大能嘱咐后人，要防我出世报复，因此她也留了一手，我需彻底抹除身上的异法这才能摆脱她的徒子徒孙的追踪。

8250208.en: <ta1>'s eyebrows flick up in surprise at your words. Her eyes hold a storm of emotions.
8250208.ch: {name|B}听了你这话，秀眉不自觉的微微一轩，眼中透出复杂的神采。

8250209.en: Believe it or not, this master cultivator's a force of nature. Her mind is razor-sharp, and she carries herself with such poise. I can't help but respect her.
8250209.ch: 说来可笑，其实这位大能乃是一名奇女子。她见识高绝，气度雍容，着实叫人心折。

8250210.en: I started out just curious, but now I'm stumped. She's vanished into thin air. Even if I wanted to get back at her, I wouldn't have a clue where to start.
8250210.ch: 我打开始也只是想着查明她在做的事。可如今，我百般查探，发现她已没了踪影，真要报仇也无从报起。

8250211.en: Being locked up drained a lot of my power. I'm much weaker than you now. We need someone with some serious skills to pull this off.
8250211.ch: 姐姐受困后，一身修为几乎全部丧失，与你相比尚且远远不如，因此若要行事，还需高人相助。

8250212.en: And that someone, of course, is you, my little goofball.
8250212.ch: 呵呵，这位高人当然便是小笨蛋你了。

8250213.en: I need to lie low for now. If her followers find out I'm here, they'll be on my tail in no time.
8250213.ch: 眼下我只能尽量隐藏形迹，否则必然遭到那位大能的后辈大举追捕。

8250214.en: I think I know how to break this curse. I could use your help to make it happen.
8250214.ch: 而我对于如何剔除自己身上的祸患已经有了眉目了。所以便想你一起去办了这事。

8250215.en: I... am hoping you'll come with me.

8250216.en: This place is a Feng Shui hotspot. I never thought she'd see me as such a threat that she'd use Feng Shui to hold me down.
8250216.ch: 这便是其中一处风水枢纽，没想到那位对我如此看重，不惜以风水之法对我进行钳制。

8250217.en: I'm trying to figure out this whole Feng Shui layout. Can you find some things for me?
8250217.ch: 现今我试着捋清这边风水局的脉络，想请你设法给我找些东西来。

8250218.en: Hey, where are those things, you little goofball? I'm getting all sweaty here. You wouldn't just leave me hanging, would you?
8250218.ch: 小笨蛋，东西还没找到吗？姐姐在这边等着，热得大汗淋漓的，你也不忍心吧？

8250220.en: Once you get the things, <ta1> waves her hand, and a stone platform rises up from the ground. It has a golden lock on it. <ta1> kicks it to pieces without even thinking twice.
8250220.ch: 你带回必要辅料后，{name|B}抬手施法，只一瞬间地上隆隆的崛起一个石台，上扣金锁。{name|B}抬脚就将东西踹烂。

8250222.en: Just as she's about to go, she sees a village down the hill. It's covered in a creepy fog. She looks worried for a second, but then her eyes light up like she has an idea. She turns to you.
8250222.ch: 她原本正想离开，但从山丘放眼看去，不远处一座小村被一股黑气笼罩。她微露惨然之色，但眼珠子转了转似乎有了主意，便又偏过看着你。

8250223.en: Hey, little goofball, that village is in trouble. If we don't do something, those villagers are going to be in real danger. Since you're already on a mission to save the day, why not help them out too?
8250223.ch: 小笨蛋，这处村庄被黑气笼罩，长此下去，村民必遭厄运。你好人做到底，一并替他们解决了吧？

8250224.en: Wow, you're such a kind little goofball. Let's do this the way we always do. I'll figure out this Feng Shui layout, and you go get the things for the spell. Then I can do my thing.
8250224.ch: 嘿，小笨蛋还挺宅心仁厚的。老办法，我设法理清风水脉络，你去给我带些辅料，我好施法。

8250225.en: Hurry up, you little goofball! Or we might end up "freeing" these villagers for good.
8250225.ch: 小笨蛋，赶紧的，要么咱都替他们解脱得了。

8250227.en: <ta1> waves her hand and casts a spell, and the village is instantly saved. The evil energy disappears, and the fog lifts. She sits down and smiles, taking in the beautiful view.
8250227.ch: {name|B}抬手施法，那村庄似乎受其施术影响，妖氛一净，黑气尽散。她满意地笑笑，坐了下来遥遥观看村中景色。

8250228.en: This place is a Feng Shui nexus. The views are amazing. It makes you feel connected to everything around you.
8250228.ch: 此处正是风水关隘，四处俱是美景形胜，看着叫人豁然开朗。

8250229.en: With all my skills, why not help these people out? It won't hurt.
8250229.ch: 姐姐神通广大，帮一帮可怜人怎么了？

8250230.en: Now that you mention it, I should've charged them for my help. But it's too late now.
8250230.ch: 哎，你这么一说倒是提醒了我。早知道应该在帮他们之前敲诈一笔，如今却是晚了。

8250232.en: <ta1> smiles at you, but her eyes are sharp, like she's trying to read your mind. After a while, her eyes soften...
8250232.ch: {name|B}微微一笑偏过头来看着你，那眼神十分锐利，仿佛要审视你心底真意一般。但过了一会神光却渐渐温柔了起来……

8250233.en: As you get closer, <ta1> looks a little flustered. Her lips part slightly, but she quickly snaps back to normal. She looks away from you, but her cheeks turn pink.
8250233.ch: {name|B}看你凑了上来，眼神稍乱，小嘴不自觉微微张开，但只瞬间便恢复了往日的锐利。她转过了头略一避开不去看你，然而俏脸却染上一片嫣红。

8250234.en: I've had enough rest. Let's go! Oh, and if you have any manuals you're working on, come by my place. I can help you understand them better.
8250234.ch: 姐姐歇息够了，这便走吧！对了，你若有什么秘籍不妨来到我的住处，我可以指点一二让你更快将所学融会贯通。

8250235.en: She looks at you for a long time, then smiles a little and looks away.
8250235.ch: 她看了你良久这才收回眼神，微微一笑。

8250236.en: You seem like you mean it. I've had enough rest. Let's go! Oh, and if you have any manuals you're working on, come by my place. I can help you understand them better.
8250236.ch: 看起来倒像是真心诚意的。姐姐歇息够了，这便走吧！对了，你若有什么秘籍不妨来到我的住处，我可以指点一二让你更快将所学融会贯通。

8250237.en: You seem to really take what I said to heart, little goofball.
8250237.ch: 看来姐姐的话对于你这小笨蛋还是有点分量的。

8250238.en: <ta1> holds out her hand. It's so fast you almost don't see it. Before you know it, her hand is in front of your face. She flicks your cheek with her finger, but it's so light you barely feel it.
8250238.ch: {name|B}说着便伸过手来，她这由静而动，几乎叫人无法察觉，当你感到她出手时，纤手已到了你面前，这突如其来的施袭叫人防不胜防，然而最后她却只是扣着食指，轻轻在你脸上弹了一下，其温和轻柔，甚至没将你的脸颊弹出痛感。

8250240.en: Yeah, the world isn't fair. There are a lot of people who are really struggling. We can't help everyone.
8250240.ch: 也是。天地不仁，可怜的家伙太多，我们帮不了每一个人。

8250241.en: Oh, and if you have any manuals you're working on, come by my place. I can help you understand them better.
8250241.ch: 对了，之后你若有什么秘籍不妨来到我的住处，我可以指点一二让你更快将所学融会贯通。

8250242.en: You head off on your own, but when you look back, <ta1>'s already on her way to the village.
8250242.ch: 你独自离开了，然则回看{name|B}，她却径往那村庄而去。

8250243.en: She's finding materials around there and then uses her fan to cast a spell. The creepy fog around the village disappears, and then she leaves.
8250243.ch: 她四处搜罗材料，最后回到这便举起手中的扇子施术去解除那村庄的黑气，这才独自离去。

8250244.en: You hear <ta1> nearby, yelling at someone. She's trying to get information out of them...
8250244.ch: 你听得附近{name|B}正在附近峻声审讯，似乎在逼问什么……

8250245.en: I couldn't figure out what that Venerable One of yours was doing... Now I see. She's using Feng Shui, and it has something to do with the Nether Air.
8250245.ch: 我百思不得其解，你们那位尊者究竟在做什么……直到刚刚我才有些眉目，你们那位尊者挪移风水，与冥气有关……

8250246.en: She wants to... destroy this world!

8250247.en: No way! She only wants to save the world. Don't talk bad about her like that!
8250247.ch: 呸！尊者只想挽救八荒，你不要信口雌黄，污蔑于她！

8250248.en: Why even talk to her? Does she think anyone who falls for her tricks ends up okay? We did the right thing. We can feel good about ourselves. This world might still be in trouble, but at least everyone else is better off.
8250248.ch: 哼，跟她说什么？落在她手里还想着能有什么好下场吗？我们做的事对得起天地良心，八荒的命数不会改变，但现如今一切生灵却变得更好了！

8250249.en: You... Are you guys crazy? You're still so loyal to her, even though she's gone... This is always a problem. Finding her is really hard...
8250249.ch: 啊！你们……都昏头了吗？一个不在了的人，竟还叫你们如此忠心……每次都是这样，要找到她可真不容易……

8250250.en: Something's wrong. You hear <ta1> stomping her foot before she walks away indignantly...
8250250.ch: 似乎发生了什么事，但听远处{name|B}似乎一跺脚悻悻的走了……

8250252.en: This place is made of green bamboo. Inside, the simple room has only a bed and a desk. Bookshelves line the walls, filled with books and scrolls. The air smells like the earthy smell of books and ink.
8250252.ch: 此处以青竹为庐，内室只置一榻一案，墙边都是书柜，上面整齐排列书籍竹简，隐隐能嗅到一股书墨之气。

8250253.en: Oh? Listen, little goofball. I need your help. Will you come with me?
8250253.ch: 噢？小笨蛋，姐姐有个事想要你帮忙，你随我来好吧？

8250254.en: Following <ta1>'s lead, you arrive at the spot. A magnificent pavilion looms before you. The area around it is deserted and shadowy, but the pavilion itself looks well-kept, like someone's been tending to it.
8250254.ch: 你依{name|B}指点来到指定的地方，只见前方一栋华丽的楼阁耸立眼前，这边黑压压的似乎已经无人居住，但阁楼仍然十分崭新，似乎有人一直维护。

8250255.en: Interesting. I didn't expect it to be so nice. Let's go inside and check it out.
8250255.ch: 有意思，姐姐倒没想过是个这样安闲舒适的所在。咱们进去看看？

8250256.en: I'm not sure what this place is all about. I found a bunch of important Feng Shui spots. This one was the hardest to find, so I thought it might be really special. That's why I came here first.
8250256.ch: 说实话，我也不太清楚这是什么地方，只是发现了几个极大的风水枢纽。而这个最不容易察觉，我估计此处较为特别，便先来到此处看看。

8250257.en: Be careful. This place might look nice, but something's not right. Maybe I'm planning something against you, you know?
8250257.ch: 一切小心，此处看起来是个舒适的住处，但总有种奇怪的感觉，指不定是姐姐要算计你噢。

8250258.en: With a playful laugh, <ta1> steps into the pavilion and starts looking around. A cold glint flashes in her eyes. She starts to inject her energy into it. A hidden door swings open, revealing a dark passageway.
8250258.ch: {name|B}嬉笑着从容进入楼阁，一边翻弄周边物事，一边仔细观察，她眼中寒光一闪，然后朝着眼前一个司南盘灌入灵力。果然一扇暗门洞开，让出一条漆黑的道路。

8250259.en: You follow her into the passage. Inside, you find a study. Simple desks are surrounded by towering bookshelves, twice your height, filled with countless rare books. She quickly starts searching through the shelves, looking for something specific.
8250259.ch: 你们进入暗道后，却见乃是一个书房，简易的案桌周围都是两人高的书柜，里面珍藏典籍更是数之不尽。她急忙四处翻看，似乎想找到什么线索。

8250260.en: Seriously? Why didn't you do this sooner? Were you scared you might die and wanted a way out?
8250260.ch: 真是的，什么事不提前处理好，非要来到这边才鼓捣，你是怕突然死掉好留个后路吗？

8250261.en: The inner chamber offers a breathtaking view: a vast lake shimmering beneath the stars and moon. Back inside, you see a black robe folded neatly. You picture a scholar gazing out from this platform, pondering the universe's mysteries.
8250261.ch: 内屋有一处观景小台，依栏远观，可见远方大湖，其时星月悬空，映入平湖，放眼看去，俱是寒星，不辨天地。回入内室，可见一袭黑色长袍整齐叠好。可以想见往日之时，必有名士，于此凭栏观星，笑谈天地。

8250262.en: The study is full of notes about Nether Air. There are little crystals on the pages, just like the ones from the Nether Mountains Qi Condensation. There's also a pile of letters about Feng Shui problems. The letters don't have names on them, so you don't know who wrote them.
8250262.ch: 小楼之中似乎颇多关于冥气的研究札记，页扉中附着一些晶体粉尘，绝似冥山结晶。旁边还有一叠信件，俱都是来报各处风水问题，但信笺下方却无署名，不知为何人所呈。

8250263.en: You find some ancient manuals on the bookshelves. They're full of valuable insights. They must have been written by individuals of great wisdom.
8250263.ch: 你于书柜上找到若干秘籍，秘籍虽然老旧，但当中义理深邃，似为前人千锤百炼之作。

8250264.en: <ta1> opens a fancy box with several documents and a jade-like item inside. Her eyes light up with excitement, like she just found what she was looking for. Suddenly, flames appear in the pavilion. Ghostly blue flames dance around, quickly filling the inner chamber with an eerie, blue glow.
8250264.ch: {name|B}正打开一个锦盒，里面放着若干文书与一件形如玉版的器物，她眼中光芒一盛，似乎终于找到想要的东西。然而就在此时，阁楼之中突然无端起火，回顾过去，只见一个个幽蓝色的火舌四处乱窜，顷刻之间将内室变成一片湛蓝的火海。

8250265.en: Ah, this is... Nether Flames. She must see me coming.
8250265.ch: 啊！这是……冥焰。她已经算到我会来此查探……

8250266.en: <ta1> tries to douse the flames licking at the box, but the Nether Fire just roars back at her. Every try makes the papers inside burst into flames. With no choice, <ta1> shoves the half-burned jade tablet into her robe.
8250266.ch: {name|B}想要扑灭手中锦盒的火焰，然而冥火见风即长，她连施手段，反使盒中文书变作一团火球。{name|B}无奈之下，唯有将已被烧毁一半的玉版，揣在怀里。

8250268.en: You and <ta1> bolt from the building, putting as much distance between us and the place as possible. In the distance, a weird blue light lights up half the sky. The flames pulse and flicker, and a huge boom echoes. The once-beautiful pavilion crumbles into dust, gone forever.
8250268.ch: 你与{name|B}急步离开楼阁走得远远的这才停住。只见远方蓝光照亮半个黑夜。焰光吞吐中，但听震鸣声起，那栋华丽的阁楼碎成一地残骸，不复原貌。

8250269.en: I... I have some things to take care of. I'll head back alone. You go focus on your training, little goofball...
8250269.ch: 我……姐姐有点事，自个回了，小笨蛋你自个修炼去吧……

8250270.en: As you approach <ta1>'s place, she seems to anticipate your arrival. She steps out, mid-spell, swirling mist coalescing into the shape of a white tiger around her hands. A casual wave of her hand dissipates the spectral beast. A warm smile spreads across her face.
8250270.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，里面的人似乎已经知晓有人造访，径自迎了出来。其时{name|B}似在施行什么异法，手中氤氲萦绕，幻成白虎，她眼看是你，便扬了扬手，将手中烟气拂去，这才笑眯眯的看着你。

8250271.en: Well, well, my little goofball. Have you come to visit me?

8250272.en: Just a little trick to bypass some Feng Shui seals. I was testing it out and didn't expect you to show up.
8250272.ch: 呵，不过是个解除风水禁制的小把戏，才刚刚钻研出来，便试演一番，没想到你就来了。

8250273.en: I used to be the one outsmarting everyone, you know? Now, I'm the one getting outmaneuvered. It's quite shocking.
8250273.ch: 嘿嘿，不是姐姐自夸。若在往昔，一向只有姐姐算计旁人的份，这次脱困复出，却一直被人算计，心中多少有点吃惊。

8250274.en: Help... Actually... Listen, there's something that I need your help with.
8250274.ch: 帮忙……嗯，我另有要……啊，我想起重要的事，需你助我。

8250275.en: I know of a place that's under a geomancy seal. I hope you can help me break it.
8250275.ch: 我知道一个地方受到堪舆术的压制，我希望你能帮我去解开禁制。

8250276.en: I need to keep searching for more suppressed Feng Shui power spots. Don't miss me too much, my little goofball. Now that I'm free, the world's my oyster. I can come and go as I please. We'll have adventures together soon enough, haha.
8250276.ch: 姐姐要在这边继续寻找下一个被压制的风水关隘，小笨蛋，不要舍不得姐姐。我身上的禁制解除了，从此天高海阔，任意来去。到时自会与你结伴游玩。嘿嘿。

8250277.en: Off you go, then. I can't wait to hear from you.
8250277.ch: 快去，姐姐等你的好消息。

8250278.en: You're a bit greedy, but your drive to improve is admirable. I like your style. Follow my directions, and you'll find some hidden manuals there. Why not dig them up and use them for your cultivation?
8250278.ch: 虽然有点贪心，但力求上进，姐姐很喜欢你这款。你依我指示前往，此地有当有秘籍暗藏，你不妨将之起出修炼。

8250279.en: Ahead, distant mountains hold a body of water, fed by rivers from all sides. It's a unique Feng Shui spot.
8250279.ch: 前方远山含水，广纳四方河川，一看而知，乃是一个特殊的风水格局之地。

8250280.en: Following <ta1>'s instructions, you cast a spell to break the seal. Suddenly, a swarm of green serpents bursts out, hissing and lunging at you.
8250280.ch: 你依{name|B}指示，施法破除此地禁制，但没料周围冒出大量青蛇，嘶嘶嘶的尽往你身上扑来。

8250281.en: These serpents seem to be under a curse, making them impossible to repel normally. Just as you realize you're in trouble, they coil around you, leaving you paralyzed.
8250281.ch: 这些青蛇似被加以禁咒，无法以寻常方法打退。正觉为难之际，这些青蛇已经缠住你四肢头足，叫你难以动弹。

8250282.en: Things get worse when a coatl emerges from the ground, its huge eyes on you and its sharp fangs bared. Wisps of smoke in front of you change into four different beasts, over and over.
8250282.ch: 更为严峻的是此时一只鸣蛇从地上爬出，瞪着铜铃大眼，露着尖锐利齿缓缓朝你挪来。同时面前烟气聚散，不断幻化四种灵兽形象。

8250283.en: You're frozen as the coatl creeps closer. You can see every tiny flaw on its deadly fangs...
8250283.ch: 你动弹不得，然则鸣蛇逐渐逼近，那獠牙上的一点瑕疵已可清晰看见……

8250284.en: Its foul breath washes over you. You're still paralyzed...
8250284.ch: 你动弹不得，然则鸣蛇进一步逼近，它口中喷出的腥臭之气，已喷到你面门……

8250285.en: Its massive jaws open wide, ready to bite. In a flash, it tears you to shreds. You're still paralyzed...
8250285.ch: 你动弹不得，鸣蛇张开大口朝你一口咬来，然后将你片片撕碎……

8250286.en: You break the seal! The green serpents loosen their grip, and you're free. The coatl roars and lunges at you, its fangs bared.
8250286.ch: 你解开了此地禁制，缠住你手足青蛇纷纷溃烂掉落，松开了对你的束缚，此时鸣蛇发现你已能自如行动，立即发声啸吼朝你咬来。

8250288.en: You get to <ta1>'s place, but it's empty. <ta1> must have gone on a trip.
8250288.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，但里面空无一人，似乎{name|B}出行远去。

8250289.en: As you explore the room, <ta1> suddenly glides in. She looks surprised for a moment, but quickly regains her composure.
8250289.ch: 你走进屋内四处浏览，就在此际，{name|B}从外进来，翩然而回。她看了你一眼，神情微微错愕，但瞬间就恢复往日静定自如的神色。

8250290.en: Just as you're about to leave, <ta1> suddenly glides in. She looks surprised for a moment, but quickly regains her composure.
8250290.ch: 就在你转身离开之际，{name|B}从外进来，翩然而回。她看了你一眼，神情微微错愕，但瞬间就恢复往日静定自如的神色。

8250291.en: Hey, how nice of you to visit me! That's the spirit. Say, there's another place I'd like to check out. Why don't you go for me?
8250291.ch: 呦，这么好来找姐姐？这就对了，姐姐还有一个地方想要走一趟，你替我担个风险去一下如何？

8250292.en: Oh? I was feeling tired, but that's certainly piqued my interest. Tell me more.
8250292.ch: 哦？原本姐姐有些累了，但你这么说，倒叫姐姐来了兴致。说下去。

8250293.en: So, you're saying it's not the place that's suspicious, it's me?
8250293.ch: 所以你是说，不是那个地方蹊跷，是我有蹊跷。

8250294.en: Oh yes, I was bored and thought the view looked nice. So I sent you on a little vacation.
8250294.ch: 是，姐姐闲的没事，看那边风光独好，因此让你去度个假。

8250295.en: Oh, you little goofball, you're anything but stupid. I could never truly keep you trapped.
8250295.ch: 小笨蛋，你又不蠢，姐姐可困不住你。

8250296.en: Let me think... You're saying there was a seal I set up for you.
8250296.ch: 等我想想，你的意思是，那边的确是有禁制，不过是我为你准备的禁制。

8250297.en: I tried to trap you, but I was afraid of hurting you. So I showed you how to break the seal, hoping you'd learn subtly and free yourself later.
8250297.ch: 但我既想困住你，又怕会不小心害了你。因此试演了解封之法，希望你暗中领悟，到时解除束缚，摆脱困境。

8250298.en: That's a bit absurd and far-fetched, isn't it?
8250298.ch: 这多少有点异想天开，而且有些荒谬。

8250299.en: <ta1> paces around you, tapping her fan against her palm, thinking about what you said.
8250299.ch: {name|B}一边绕着你漫步绕圈，一边用手拍打着手中折扇，似乎在不断推理你说过的话。

8250300.en: You hit the nail on the head!

8250301.en: <ta1>'s eyes flash as she points her fan. Suddenly, you're frozen.
8250301.ch: {name|B}眼中射出锐光，手中折扇虚空一点，你登时动弹不得。

8250302.en: The Four Symbols Seal couldn't hold you, but this Five Elements Seal is twice as strong. This time, it'll keep you here.
8250302.ch: 四象印留你不住，这个五行印繁复一倍，怎么也能将你留住了。

8250303.en: Oh, you little goofball. I've been busy and need some peace. You seem restless, so I'll have to keep you here. Don't worry—this room is a retreat for hermits. Enjoy it while you're here.
8250303.ch: 小笨蛋，最近姐姐有点心事，想要自己一个静静，你看起来又不大安分，只好让委屈你留在此处了。姐姐的房子正是隐士韬晦之所，小笨蛋不妨在里面享受享受。

8250305.en: Wonderful! I can relax knowing you're handling this.
8250305.ch: 真好，将事情交给你，姐姐最是放心了。

8250306.en: <ta1> giggles, but then her eyes flash again. She points her fan, and you're frozen.
8250306.ch: {name|B}嘻嘻的笑着，突然间眼中射出锐光，手中折扇虚空一点，你登时动弹不得。

8250309.en: How cruel! You're breaking my heart!
8250309.ch: 如此决绝，让姐姐好生伤心呢！

8250313.en: After breaking the seal, you find a pile of charred pages on <ta1>'s desk. In a cabinet, there are several books about geomancy.
8250313.ch: 你破去{name|B}对你设下的禁制，只见她的案桌上有一叠已经被烧焦的书页，内柜之中有若干与堪舆相关的书籍。

8250314.en: You recognize the charred spiritual item as part of what you saved from the fire at the pavilion.
8250314.ch: 你查看烧焦的灵物，正是日前查探那栋楼阁时抢火焰中抢回的部分。

8250315.en: The spiritual item, though damaged by the flames, is still beautiful. The jade fragment is smooth as a mirror, showing how well-made it once was.
8250315.ch: 一件已经被幽火烧毁的灵物，剩下的残件仍可见玉版平整如镜，未损坏时当是极精致的宝物。

8250316.en: A man in black sits by the railing, talking to a woman in purple robes. They seem to be discussing something important.
8250316.ch: 黑衣男子凭栏而坐，紫衣女子站在一，正与之商量什么重要之事。

8250317.en: Hmph, I always thought this world was full of people who were all show and no substance. I never expected this person to...
8250317.ch: 哼，我只道这世上虚有其表者多，而真才实学者少，倒没想此人真有几分本事。

8250318.en: <ta1>'s insight is amazing—truly rare in the entire world. She's gentle on the outside but strong inside. She walks the line between good and evil. But at her core, she's fundamentally good.
8250318.ch: {name|B}极有见地，我于八荒，生平仅见。惜乎其人，外柔内刚，看似亦正亦邪，实则心地善良。

8250319.en: If we told her everything, she'd fight against us. I don't want to make such a powerful enemy.
8250319.ch: 若向其坦言一切，势必掀起一场风波。竖此空前强敌，非我所愿。

8250320.en: During our debate, we had a brief fight. <ta1> seems to have seen a secret deep inside me. This could be a weakness for me, and I need to protect myself from it.
8250320.ch: {name|B}与我论道之际曾试着交手，她似乎窥破了我内心一点隐秘，这将成为我的隐患，需设法防范。

8250321.en: Two women, one in purple robes and one in black, stand side by side, gazing out at distant mountains. A wind whips through their hair.
8250321.ch: 紫衣女子与墨衣女子并肩站着，临风观看远方山色。

8250322.en: Honestly, I can't wait to take you on again.
8250322.ch: 说实话，我倒挺想再和你比试比试。

8250323.en: What's this? You trying to kill me?

8250324.en: Maybe I don't have any bad blood towards you.
8250324.ch: 有没有可能，我对你并没有敌意？

8250325.en: Hmph, who knows if you're being straight with me or just playing games.
8250325.ch: 哼，谁知道你真心还是假意。

8250326.en: Remember our last debate? We saw into each other's souls.
8250326.ch: 那次论道，我们彼此窥心，已经洞见大家心底的一切。

8250327.en: We're cut from the same cloth, and I can't resist the connection we have. Who wouldn't want a soulmate?
8250327.ch: 有时候我觉得你和我很像，让我不禁生出亲近的想法，试问天下间，谁又能拒绝一个真正的知心人呢？

8250329.en: The woman in purple robes offers a faint, knowing smile. She says nothing more, simply standing quietly to the side.
8250329.ch: 紫衣女子闻言微微一笑，也不再多说，只是静静的站在旁边。

8250330.en: Leave him. You don't need him. You're strong enough on your own.
8250330.ch: 离开那个人。人贵自立，离了他你也能有自己的一番作为。

8250331.en: For now, let's just enjoy each other's company. We can talk about something else later...
8250331.ch: 今日聚首，只谈风月，不说其它……

8250332.en: You're right, who could resist a true kindred spirit? But if we keep going down this road, I'm afraid our friendship won't last...
8250332.ch: 你说得对，谁能拒绝一个真正的知心人？但这样下去，咱们这朋友可做不长了……

8250333.en: A fierce magical duel breaks out between the purple-clad woman and <ta1>. The battlefield is engulfed in chaos as mountains crumble around them. Debris and fragments, charged with their energies, dance in the air, defying gravity.
8250333.ch: {name|B}与一名紫衣女子彼此斗法，场中一片混乱，周围山体相继崩塌，乱石碎屑受他们灵力激发，浮空了落地，落地了浮空，浑无休止。

8250334.en: I didn't expect you to find this place.
8250334.ch: 找到这里来，倒是叫人始料不及。

8250335.en: I don't know what you're up to, but it's not good. Please stop. This isn't you.
8250335.ch: 我不知道你们到底在做什么，但必是很可怕的事。收手吧，你不是那样的人。

8250336.en: I can be anyone I want to be!
8250336.ch: 若有必要，我可以成为任何人！

8250337.en: You're blinded by your own power!

8250338.en: With a graceful movement, <ta1> transforms into a plume of inky smoke, surging towards her enemy. The woman in purple robes, refusing to yield, metamorphoses into a violet light to engage in combat. Their fierce struggle reaches a stalemate, then explodes in a blast of energy. When the dust settles, the purple-clad woman lies half-prone on the ground, a trickle of blood at the corner of her mouth. <ta1> regards her with a cold, calculating stare.
8250338.ch: {name|B}素手轻挽个半圆，自身化作墨烟，径往敌人冲去。紫衣女并不示弱，幻为紫光与之相搏。两人相持不下，终于诱发灵爆，烟尘落定后，紫衣女半躺地上，嘴角流着一丝鲜血。{name|B}则冷冷的看着她。

8250339.en: You held back... If you'd used the Sky Double Pupils, you could've won...
8250339.ch: 你留手了……若用青空重瞳必能挽回败局……

8250340.en: Hmph, you read my mind and exploited my weaknesses. That's not a fair fight!
8250340.ch: 哼，你窥破我的心境，利用我的弱点，胜得殊不光彩！

8250341.en: I didn't come here to prove who's stronger... We're kind of alike. I... I don't want to see you lose your way.
8250341.ch: 我不是来与你分个高下的……我们都有点相似，我……不想你误入歧途。

8250342.en: When the right way is lost, people cling to their own ideas of what's right. When wisdom grows, hypocrisy follows. You say I've lost my way, but tell me—what is the right way?
8250342.ch: 大道废，有仁义，智慧出，有大伪。你以我为歧途，那你先说说什么是正道？

8250343.en: We're not having this conversation right now. I need to get you away from here. You won't come to your senses until you're away from him!
8250343.ch: 我们不讨论这个，今日我必须将你带走，离了那人，你才能清醒一些！

8250344.en: As <ta1> helps the purple-clad woman up, a manual floats out of her chest. <ta1>'s expression changes. Before she can react, the book starts to glow energy. It swallows her whole and then falls to the ground. Night Rain coughs and stands up. She picks up the manual and tucks it away.
8250344.ch: {name|B}俯身将紫衣女子扶起，就在此时，女子怀中秘籍突然自行漂出，翩翩然如蝶舞霰飞。{name|B}神色剧变，正要反应，不想那书扉页哗啦啦的翻动同时释出灵力，竟将她吸了进去。那本秘籍将人吸走以后落在地上兀自弹动几下这才复归寂然。夜雨楼咳嗽两声，挣扎站起，上前拿走秘籍，重新将之收入怀中。

8250345.en: I'm sorry. I didn't want to hurt you, but I couldn't let you interfere with our plans... The fan that breaks seals is now yours. Maybe one day, if you really understand me, you can escape the Aether Breath Manual and be free.
8250345.ch: 抱歉，我不想杀你，但也不能放任你妨碍我们……破解封印的折扇也交到你手上了，如果有朝一日你真的理解了我，定能顺利摆脱《玄息秘本》，得享自由。

8250346.en: Remember when you asked me why I'm doing all this? It's because of the pain I feel. If you could understand how much I'm hurting, maybe you wouldn't try to stop me.
8250346.ch: 我记得你问过我，这是何苦，我只能告诉你，这是情之所苦。假如你能切身体会到我的苦衷，想必那时便不会再阻止我了吧？

8250347.en: On the bookshelf, you see some research notes about Nether Air. It seems that after escaping her predicament, <ta1> did a lot of research on the Nether Mountains, Nether Air, and other related subjects.
8250347.ch: 你在书柜上看见一些钻研冥气的札记。似乎摆脱困境后{name|B}对冥山、冥气之类的有过一番研究。

8250348.en: The document contains a map showing several Feng Shui power spots. Two of these locations are already marked. There's only one left that's untouched.
8250348.ch: 图中还有几处风水关隘的地图，其中两处已被标记，仅余一次风水关隘未被破坏。

8250349.en: When the pavilion burned down, little was saved. But one thing's clear: her followers have become a huge organization. They must control a lot of important parts of this world. I never thought I'd face something this big. If I keep fighting them directly, I'll probably end up dead. I was planning to train that little goofball to do things for me. That way, even if my powers take a while to recover, I won't be completely helpless.
8250349.ch: 那天阁楼烧毁，能够抢出的资料少之又少。但可以肯定的是，她的徒子徒孙已经发展成一个极大的组织。这些人定已掌握了八荒某些不为人知的秘密。我从没想过，要面对的是这样庞大的组织。若我一直与他们针锋相对，早晚会死在他们手上吧？本拟将那个小笨蛋培养起来，能够代我行事，那么我修为一时半会无法恢复也不至于太过无力。

8250350.en: Looks like I was too hopeful. Trapped in that book, I didn't realize thousands of years had passed. They've grown into a gigantic group. If that goofball gets involved, he'll probably end up in trouble. The Feng Shui power spots related to the last shackle binding me are dangerous. That master cultivator knows she failed to take my life, so he had probably changed things around here... He's ruthless and would definitely try to kill me. It's probably a trap... but I have to deal with it. I can't cultivate or get my powers back if I don't.
8250350.ch: 如今看来，倒是我太过乐观了。我受困书中，混没料到外间已经过了千年万年。他们已经成为这么庞大的组织了，若让那笨蛋也掺和进来，早晚也会惨遭横祸的。如今可以肯定的是，与我身上最后一重枷锁相关的风水关节一定有无数风险。那位大能已经知道她没对我下杀手，因此亲自重新布置了此地……那个人，杀伐果断，定会设法将我置诸死地。不错，那一定是个陷阱……但若不了结此事，我永远无法重新修炼，恢复修为。不错，一定要了结此事。

8250352.en: Oh no! She went off on her own... What to do?
8250352.ch: 啊！她自己去了……这该如何是好？

8250353.en: I heard the Manual Pavilion had a thief recently. What's that about?
8250353.ch: 我听说琅琊阁最近出了窃贼，这是怎么回事？

8250354.en: I've heard she's a woman in a dark green robe. She's really powerful. The Manual Pavilion has offered rewards and sent people to catch her, but they've all failed.
8250354.ch: 听说是个穿着墨绿衣衫的女子，修为不差，琅琊阁几次放出悬赏派修士捕捉都失利了。

8250355.en: Tsk, she's not that powerful. But she's really smart. No wonder she's hard to catch.
8250355.ch: 哼，这女子修为不怎样，但聪明机智却是一等一的，真的不好抓。

8250356.en: Why does she hate the Manual Pavilion so much? It's weird.
8250356.ch: 为什么她总是煞费苦心与琅琊阁作对？真是奇怪了。

8250357.en: Why do you care? Why don't we try to catch her? They say she's pretty. We could have some fun with her and then turn her in. That would be perfect.
8250357.ch: 你管这么多干嘛？不如咱们也去碰碰运气，据说这女子貌美如花，抓住了一亲芳泽，然后再交给琅琊阁，不是顶好？

8250359.en: As the two of them walk, they unknowingly stray far from where they started.
8250359.ch: 二人边说边走，不知不觉间已经去得远了。

8250360.en: You arrive at the final marked Feng Shui power spot by <ta1>. The place feels really gloomy and dark.
8250360.ch: 你来到{name|B}标示的最后一处风水关键点。此地阴阴沉沉，一看而知，乃是一处死地。

8250361.en: As you go deeper, it gets hotter. You're not sure if you've gone underground. You see <ta1> hiding behind a big rock. The person is using three fingers to do calculations based on Nine Grids divination. She looks really focused and is sweating a lot.
8250361.ch: 你持续深入，身边气温渐高，不知是否已经进入地底，再往前行，果然看见{name|B}隐身在一块巨石后，以三指为九宫推演计算。她似乎正在冥思苦想，额头豆大的汗不断流下。

8250362.en: What are you doing here? You knew it was dangerous. Why did you come?
8250362.ch: 啊！你怎么来了？既知危险，那还过来？

8250363.en: Now... Pfft, you've never seen me like this before, have you? I'm usually all dignified and graceful. But seriously, you need to leave. Don't get involved in this.
8250363.ch: 这当口……噗呲，素日里姐姐端庄娴雅，却不曾见过这般光景吧？不玩笑，你这就离开，不要掺和。

8250364.en: You... You're really being goofy this time.
8250364.ch: 你……这次你可真是笨到家了。

8250365.en: Let me be clear: this place is really dangerous. If you're smart, you'll leave. We've had adventures before, but those were calculated risks. This place is not safe.
8250365.ch: 姐姐现在郑重与你说明白，此处十分危险，知机的话，赶紧离开。往日虽在冒险，但我心里有数，今日此处，绝非善地。

8250366.en: <ta1> looks confused, takes a deep breath, and looks at you coldly.
8250366.ch: {name|B}满脸困惑，她吸了一口气，压住心中波澜，这才冷冷的看着你。

8250367.en: Listen, I didn't set you up this time. You got yourself into this. From now on, do what I say. When I tell you to fight, you fight. When I tell you to run, you run. Don't do anything on your own!
8250367.ch: 你可要记住，这回不是姐姐给你下套，这是你自找麻烦。待会听我的，我要你打，你就打，我让你逃，你就逃。断不可自作主张！

8250368.en: I've been waiting for you. A long time.

8250369.en: The Venerable One's prediction was right. We knew you'd fall right into our trap.
8250369.ch: 尊者神算，早知你会自投罗网。

8250371.en: The Venerable One said we can't let them change the Feng Shui power spot of this place.
8250371.ch: 尊者有令，不可让他们扭转此处风水关隘。

8250373.en: You little goofball, stand your ground! I'm not dealing with them anymore!
8250373.ch: 小笨蛋，你守着，姐姐可没耐心再跟他们纠缠！

8250374.en: Tsk, go ahead and open it. You're screwed either way...
8250374.ch: 呵，尽管开……不开你是死，开了你也是死……

8250375.en: Hmph, your master is hiding in the shadows. He's probably not very good. I'm not afraid of him.
8250375.ch: 哼，你的主子藏头露尾的，想来也没什么真本事，我可不怕他。

8250376.en: <ta1> waves her hand, and the dark land suddenly bursts into light. Countless monsters start howling. A huge noise approaches, like thousands of horses running. You look closer and see a massive horde of demons charging towards you!
8250376.ch: {name|B}挥手挽了个圈，眼前这片黑压压的荒地突然大放光芒。就在此时，无数妖物啸叫声此起彼伏，隆隆之声由远而近，仿佛万马奔腾。仔细一看，竟是无数妖怪朝你这边冲了过来！

8250377.en: You manage to kill and push back some of the monsters attacking you, but there are too many. They keep coming, like a never-ending flood.
8250377.ch: 你杀退部分冲到前方的妖兽，然而来犯的妖兽络绎不绝，仿佛秋水时至，浩浩荡荡。

8250379.en: Hey, don't worry about me. I have my own tricks. If you don't leave now, you'll be torn apart.
8250379.ch: 呵，你管姐姐怎么办呢？我自有妙计。再不走，小心被妖兽撕成碎片。

8250380.en: Just go! Don't get in my way when I wipe them all out!
8250380.ch: 走！不要妨碍姐姐在这大杀四方！

8250381.en: <ta1>'s urging you to leave, but the monsters are already flooding in...
8250381.ch: {name|B}正在催促，但那些妖兽早已潮水般涌至……

8250382.en: You fight off wave after wave of attackers, but there are too many of them...
8250382.ch: 你杀退一批一批又一批，然则妖兽却似无穷无尽……

8250383.en: Go... Just go! Now! I don't have any power. I can't escape. You're different...
8250383.ch: 走吧……你走！快！我身无修为，根本没办法脱身！你不同……

8250384.en: Tears well up in <ta1>'s eyes, but the moment of vulnerability passes quickly. She grits her teeth, opens the fan, and starts chanting. Tiny characters appear on the fan. With a quick look, <ta1> understands what they mean and starts to cast a spell. A loud roar comes from the wasteland. In a second, the mountains crumble and the rocks break apart, destroying all the monsters nearby.
8250384.ch: {name|B}眼中泪光涌动，但这脆弱的神色转瞬即逝，她咬了咬牙，打开了手中的折扇，嘴里低吟真言，下一刻她手中的折扇，显出无数小字。{name|B}稍一阅读，立知机要，她同时施法，这荒地之中突然发出轰鸣，只一瞬间周围山崩石裂，连着周围妖兽一并灭杀。

8250385.en: I see... Now let's get out of here.

8250386.en: <ta1> leads you away from the area. When you reach the entrance, she casts another spell with the fan. The ground collapses with a loud explosion. When the dust settles, there's just a big area of ruins with the monsters buried deep underground...
8250386.ch: {name|B}带着你离开此地，你们回到入口后，她再次以折扇施法，地面突然崩毁陷落，但听炸雷声响，前方冒起大量烟尘，再看时前方已成一片废墟，妖兽也已掩埋地底……

8250388.en: You make it, but she seems distracted and sad. <ta1> gives you a small smile and walks away, lost in thought.
8250388.ch: 虽已解决了目前危机，但{name|B}却有点心神不属，看着似乎有点难过，又有点疑惑。她朝你微微一笑然后自顾自的走了。

8250389.en: Well, that's better. I'll see you soon.
8250389.ch: 哼，这才是嘛，姐姐稍后就到。

8250390.en: You arrive at <ta1>'s home, but it's empty. It seems <ta1>'s gone out and hasn't come back yet.
8250390.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，然则里面空无人一人。{name|B}似乎外出未归。

8250391.en: You arrive at <ta1>'s place, but there's no sign of her. A thin layer of dust coats the desk inside.
8250391.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，{name|B}却没在里面，但看内室案桌已薄积尘埃。

8250392.en: You arrive at <ta1>'s place. A thin layer of dust coats the desk inside, suggesting she's been gone for a while...
8250392.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，内室积聚尘埃，{name|B}看来已经很久没有回到住处……

8250393.en: You find her back at her place. <ta1>'s standing in the courtyard, staring off into space, looking a bit down. But as soon as she sees you, her face lights up with mischief.
8250393.ch: 你来到书庐，只见{name|B}已回到住处，其时她正站在屋外小院中凭栏远眺，眉目之间却颇含哀愁。不过她看你来到，玉容立即显出几分狡狯。

8250394.en: Perfect timing. I actually need a favor.
8250394.ch: 你来得好，我正好有事要你帮忙。

8250395.en: Yeah, I need a favor. Just take it easy and stand still.
8250395.ch: 嗯，确有意图，不过这次不难办，你只需站定即可。

8250396.en: Aww, you're such a sweetie, you little goofball.

8250397.en: As you stand motionless, {name|B} slowly draws near. Her face approaches yours, and she plants a soft, fleeting kiss on your cheek.
8250397.ch: 你站定之后，{name|B}轻轻凑近，脸儿靠了过来，蜻蜓点水般在你脸上吻了一下。

8250398.en: Before you can even blink, <ta1> is already a few steps away.
8250398.ch: 你还要搞明白怎么回事，{name|B}却已重新远远的站了开去。

8250399.en: That's it. I will handle the rest.
8250399.ch: 好了，剩下的事，由姐姐自己处理吧。

8250400.en: There's still a lot I need to figure out. It won't be easy, but I have to keep looking. If you run into any problems in the manuals, come find me. I can help you.
8250400.ch: 有些事，我还是想要弄明白。可能会很艰难，但我必须追寻下去。如果秘籍上有什么疑难不妨来此找我，姐姐定会给你指点一二的。

8250401.en: <ta1> waves goodbye and disappears. Where is she going? She is still somewhere in this world, exploring its far-flung corners. Maybe, if fate allows, your paths will cross again soon.
8250401.ch: {name|B}朝你挥了挥手，然后逐渐去远。她会去哪呢？所幸苍天所及，土地所覆，都不过八荒之内，若是机缘到了，也许你们之间很快就又会再次邂逅。

8250402.en: Ha, look at you. All grown up and not listening to me anymore, huh?
8250402.ch: 哈，翅膀长硬了，现在都不听姐姐的话了。

8250403.en: {name|B} bites her lip, a trace of displeasure shown on her face. But then she smiles, tilts her head, and leans in close to plant a soft, fleeting kiss on your cheek.
8250403.ch: {name|B}说着咬着嘴唇，脸上微蕴不悦之色。但最终她还是笑了笑然后偏着头朝你凑了过来，蜻蜓点水般在你脸上吻了一下。

8250404.en: Still don't get it? Curiosity can get you into trouble. What do you want to know?
8250404.ch: 不明白？好奇心可是会害死人的。呵呵，说吧，想知道什么呢？

8250405.en: You know... I've learned a thing or two. Turns out, the one who locked me up was playing a game. It's a long story.
8250405.ch: 其实……姐姐只不过想明白了一些事情而已，原来困住我的人跟我开了个玩笑，不过此事说来话长。

8250406.en: Her name is Lou Ye. Honestly, I really like her. When we first met, it felt like we'd been friends forever.
8250406.ch: 她啊，自称娄夜。呵，其实姐姐挺喜欢她的，与她初见即有一见如故之感。

8250407.en: At first, I thought it was just wishful thinking. After she locked me up, I wanted to get back at her. But then I realized her true intentions.
8250407.ch: 我本以为这是我一厢情愿的想法。甚至被她困住之后，我还想狠狠地报复她。只不过，就在日前我才明白了她的深意。

8250408.en: She feels the same way about me. She cares about me a lot, maybe even more than I care about her. Hey, you're actually pretty smart, you little goofball. But Lou Ye? She's totally clueless.
8250408.ch: 其实她对我也是一般，十分珍惜，甚至比我珍惜她更珍惜我。小笨蛋，你是聪明人，可这个娄夜前辈啊，却是个十足的蠢人。

8250409.en: In the past, I was trying to find out some things. I went looking everywhere, and I accidentally made Lou Ye and this master cultivator, her backer, angry.
8250409.ch: 姐姐以前想搞清楚一些问题，于是四处查探，不经意间，已经得罪了娄夜以及她身后的一名绝世大能。

8250410.en: That master cultivator wanted me dead. But Lou Ye, who was supposed to kill me, didn't want to. She was stuck between a rock and a hard place.
8250410.ch: 那位大能要杀死我，好抹除所有障碍。但代为处置的娄夜，既不愿意背叛那位大能，也不愿意杀我，夹在中间左右为难。

8250411.en: So she came up with a plan. She used some geomancy magic to trap me in Aether Breath Manual. I lost track of time and all my power.
8250411.ch: 于是她想了个法子，以堪舆之法在玄息秘本中炼出一片空间，将我困在里面。我在里面不知时间流逝，同时修为都被消耗殆尽。

8250412.en: As a result, I was completely drained of cultivation. Even if I escaped, I wouldn't be a threat to that master cultivator. If I stayed trapped, he'd eventually let me go, but by then, it would be too late. He'd already won.
8250412.ch: 这样一来，我身上修为涓滴无存，即使有办法脱困，也已无法成为那位大能的威胁。若我始终无法离开，她最后也会将我放出，不过那时诸事已定，我同样无法再妨碍那位大能。

8250413.en: That master cultivator always has a plan. Once I wasn't a threat, he wouldn't want me dead anymore. By locking me up, Lou Ye was actually protecting me. She... didn't want me to die.
8250413.ch: 那位大能绝不为无益之事，我不成其威胁，自不会对我起杀心。所以娄夜困住我，也是一个保护我的法子。她……并不想我被杀死。

8250414.en: Lou Ye's a master of planning. Years ago, she sent me a challenge and this folding fan. Hidden inside was a powerful set of geomantic techniques powerful enough to manipulate the very fabric of Feng Shui, altering ley lines and shifting the flow of energy.
8250414.ch: 若论心思缜密，我可万万不及娄夜。当年她给我下战书，将我手中这柄折扇作为信物一同寄到。折扇里隐含一套堪舆之法，能改易风水，截断地脉，使周围瞬间发生剧变。

8250415.en: The fan also held the key to breaking the shackles that bound me. But there was a catch: I had to truly understand her feelings before the fan would reveal its secrets.
8250415.ch: 同时这柄扇子还留有解除我身上禁制枷锁的关键，只不过这些都被她藏起来了。若我无法体悟她的心情，这柄扇子中所有内容都无法显现。

8250416.en: In that moment, I finally got it. She loved that master cultivator deeply and would do anything to protect him.
8250416.ch: 然而那天危急之中，我却明白了一切。她是要我知道她深爱着那位大能，她可以不计代价保护他。

8250417.en: The hate inside me is hard to let go of. But when I put myself in her shoes, I'm not so sure anymore. I don't know if I could have done any better.
8250417.ch: 我承认，我心中的恨，没那么容易平息。但当我设身处地体悟到这一切后，却变得很矛盾。倘若彼我之间易地而处，我未必能做得比她好。

8250418.en: She wanted me to know that she loved that master cultivator deeply and would do anything to protect him.
8250418.ch: 她要告诉我她深爱着那位大能，她可以不惜一切保护他、帮助他。

8250419.en: That day, when you were in danger, I wanted to protect you at all costs.
8250419.ch: 那天情况危急，你身陷危险之中，我也想不惜一切的保护你。

8250420.en: This shared feeling unlocked the fan's power, and we barely escaped. It was a close call.
8250420.ch: 此番心情与她当时的心意暗中契合，折扇封印解开，显出异能，这才让你我避过一劫。

8250421.en: <ta1> is speaking calmly, but a mischievous glint appears in their eyes as she finishes.
8250421.ch: {name|B}一直淡淡的说着，但将这话说完后，脸上又复露出几分狡狯之色。

8250422.en: Just kidding! Pretty convincing story, huh?
8250422.ch: 骗你的，这慌编得还行吧？

8250423.en: What? You think I talk too much, don't you? Haha!
8250423.ch: 噢？嫌我啰嗦嘴碎了是吧？哈哈。

8250424.en: Friend, I recently received a secret bounty... and it seems you're the target. Heh... just who might you be?
8250424.ch: 朋友，我日前获得秘密悬赏，似乎要抓拿的就是你，嘿嘿，你究竟是谁？

8250425.en: Questions won't get us anywhere. Let's settle this with force.
8250425.ch: 问，是问不出来的，直接打倒吧。

8250426.en: The two emanate killing intent, ready to strike. Just then, a spark of energy within you ignites, and blue flames suddenly engulf their bodies. Screaming in panic, they drop the burning items and flee blindly into the distance.
8250426.ch: 面前二人杀气涌现，他们正要一并出手将你拦下，便在此时你身上一点灵力生发，二人大呼小叫中浑身冒起蓝焰，瞬间他们慌忙丢下燃起之物，慌不择路地逃窜到远方去了。

8250427.en: Dark arts! This one practices dark arts! A demonic cultivator deserving death! Mark my words, this humiliation will be repaid tenfold!
8250427.ch: 邪法！邪法！这人会的邪法！魔道邪修，人人得而诛之！今日之赐，来日定当十倍奉还！

8250428.en: Excellent, you left the manual behind. Here, I will grant you this as a reward. Oh, and... you don't mind that I've made a few enemies for you, do you?
8250428.ch: 很好，将秘籍留下了，姐姐将这东西赏给你好了。唔，你不介意我给你添了几个仇人吧？

8250429.en: Oh my, quite the bold one, aren't you? I just love those who fear neither heaven nor earth.
8250429.ch: 呦？还挺霸气的哈。姐姐最喜欢天不怕地不怕的人了。

8250430.en: With a slight smile, {name|B} dissolves into mist and vanishes without a trace.
8250430.ch: {name|B}微微一笑，身形一幻，化作烟气，消失不见。

8250431.en: Tsk, are you scared? Life is meant to be enjoyed—what is there to fear?
8250431.ch: 啧啧，你很怕？人生贵适意，有什么可怕的？

8250432.en: {name|B} smiles and dissolves into mist, vanishing from sight.

8250433.en: Between two adjacent mountain ridges, silvery flashes catch the eye. Upon closer inspection, you see they are sunlight reflecting off from the Wind Antelope.
8250433.ch: 前方两山毗邻，山脊之间可见隐有银光闪烁，细看之下，才发现那是风铃角马的映日闪光。

8250434.en: Good. I've sealed off the mountain pass. When they come seeking retribution, just focus on taking their manuals—leave the rest to me.
8250434.ch: 很好，我封住了山坳，来人问罪，你不需管，只需拿走他们身上秘籍即可。

8250435.en: No sooner had {name|B} finished speaking than two figures came charging in on their flying swords, bristling with anger.
8250435.ch: {name|B}话才说完，未及举步，果见两人怒气冲冲，御剑而来。

8250436.en: Hmph, you witch! I knew it was you—how dare you tamper with our mountain's Feng Shui formations! Oh? You've brought a formidable ally... No wonder you're acting so brazen.
8250436.ch: 哼，妖妇，我就知道是你，竟敢乱我山头风水禁制。哦？身边还有个高人，难怪如此肆无忌惮。

8250437.en: Indeed, it's me. Be a good little lamb and hand over what I want—I might just spare your life.
8250437.ch: 是我，乖乖交出我要的东西，饶你性命。

8250438.en: Let's just hand it over... There's no way we can win against them today...
8250438.ch: 我们先将东西交出去吧，今日无论如何也斗不过他们了……

8250439.en: Hmph! If you insist on interfering, so be it. We'll settle this score another day. But mark my words—this witch is just using you as her shield. The day will come when she meets her own gruesome end!
8250439.ch: 哼！阁下非要插手那也由你，咱们的账日后慢慢清算不迟。不过我警告你，这妖妇也不过借你来狐假虎威罢了，终有一日她会死无葬身之地的。

8250440.en: With those words, the figure departs sullenly on a flying sword.
8250440.ch: 那人说着悻悻的御剑离开了。

8250441.en: You seem full of doubt—worried about making enemies and the risks that come with it? I can only say that I had no choice. If I couldn't force them to hand over their manuals, I would soon vanish without a trace.
8250441.ch: 你看起来满腹狐疑的样子，是不是担心招惹仇人，带来风险？我只能说，这么说是迫不得已。若非逼迫这些人交出秘籍，我很快就会消失不见。

8250442.en: I like how you think. Though I must admit, I have been rather willful, bringing enemies to your doorstep for no good reason. I owe you an apology for that.
8250442.ch: 你这话很对姐姐胃口。不过姐姐确是任性了些，给你无故招来了仇敌，这里给你道个歉。

8250443.en: But then again, I wouldn't have come to trouble you if I didn't cherish, care for, and trust you so much. *chuckles*
8250443.ch: 不过话又说回来了，若非姐姐宠你爱你信你，才不会来麻烦你呢，呵呵。

8250444.en: Mid-conversation, {name|B} casts some mysterious art and becomes a streak of light as graceful as a swan, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
8250444.ch: 谈笑声中，{name|B}不知施了什么术法，身如流光，去似惊鸿，眨眼就不见了。

8250445.en: True, my actions have brought you some enemies, but haven't you received decent rewards in return? Besides, how could these pathetic demons ever be a match for you?
8250445.ch: 诚然，我这么做确是给你招来仇怨，不过你也因此获得了不错的回报吧？而且，这些妖魔小丑怎能是你的对手？

8250446.en: Furthermore, I need them to solve my own mysteries, and you profit from it too. It's a win-win situation—why pass up such a golden opportunity?
8250446.ch: 再说，姐姐要借这些书籍破解心中疑难，你能从中获利，我们合则两利，这又何乐而不为呢？

8250447.en: {name|B} gives a charming smile before dissolving like smoke, leaving behind only the cultivator's manual.
8250447.ch: 眼前{name|B}嫣然一笑，便作烟消，面前徒余修士所遗秘籍。

8250448.en: There stands {name|B} in the middle of the path, greeting your arrival with a gentle smile.
8250448.ch: 只见{name|B}候在路中央，看你来了，便微微一笑看向你。

8250449.en: Hey, are you afraid of making a few enemies?
8250449.ch: 喂，你是不是很怕结交仇人？

8250450.en: Oh? I'll hold you to those words.

8250451.en: Hmph, you deliberately lured us here, didn't you?
8250451.ch: 哼，阁下是故意招引我们过来的吧？

8250452.en: What were you planning when you unsealed the arrays in this area?
8250452.ch: 你解封附近禁制，意欲何为？

8250453.en: Suddenly, thorny vines burst from the ground, ensnaring the two and constricting them until they can barely breathe.
8250453.ch: 突然间地上荆棘突起缠住二人，将他们勒得无法喘息。

8250454.en: I'll hand it over; just let me go!

8250455.en: As soon as the cultivator finishes speaking, the thorns recede, and they frantically flee with their wounds.
8250455.ch: 面前修士话音才落，荆棘散去，他们拖着受伤的躯体忙不迭的逃了。

8250456.en: I won't forget this favor. Here, take this—I just confiscated it from those two. I have matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave now.
8250456.ch: 姐姐会记住你的好处的。这个先拿着，刚从那两人手中缴来的。我还有事，先走一步了。

8250457.en: With those words, {name|B} vanishes in the blink of an eye.
8250457.ch: {name|B}说着，身形一闪，瞬间不见了踪影。

8250459.en: {name|B} seems to give a faint smile, though disappointment flickers across her face. In a flash, she disappears without a trace.
8250459.ch: {name|B}似乎微微一笑，但情态之中却透出几分失望的味道，她只一闪身，人影瞬间不见了。

8250460.en: I've been waiting for you since I have a question. If someone were to bully me, would you help me get even? Though, you know... getting involved like this might make you some enemies.
8250460.ch: 等你好久了，姐姐有个问题想问你，若有人欺负姐姐，你能帮我出气吗？不过啊，这么一来二去，指不定就要与旁人结怨了。

8250461.en: I admire that daring spirit of yours—the way you're ready to take on the world. Oh my, here come those nasty people who've been bullying me.
8250461.ch: 姐姐就欣赏你身上有种敢于挑战天下的气概。哎呀，那些欺负姐姐的坏人来了。

8250462.en: According to our calculations, this is the one!

8250463.en: You wretched fool! How dare you tamper with the landscape formations! Seize them!
8250463.ch: 可恶的家伙，如何擅自改变前方山水禁制，快拿下他！

8250464.en: As the two prepare to attack you, their energy suddenly gets cut off. They collapse to their knees, gasping for air. One of them, trembling and fighting through the pain, pushes a book into your hands. The moment the book is sent, they relax as if finally freed from their torment.
8250464.ch: 二人拟朝你攻来，未料身上突然灵力似被阻断，一并跪倒在地呼呼喘息，其中一人强忍痛苦颤颤巍巍的将一本书籍塞到你手中。就在书籍易手的同时二人全身一松，似乎脱离了苦难。

8250465.en: So you're that witch's puppet... Mark my words, you'll pay dearly for this humiliation...
8250465.ch: 你是那妖婆的爪牙……今日之赐，来日必当补报……

8250466.en: The two vanish in a flash. {name|B}, who had disappeared sometime earlier, now appears once they're gone. With a pleased smile, she gently takes the book from your hands.
8250466.ch: 二人说着身影一掠，已然消失不见。{name|B}不知何时消失不见，此时二人遁去，她便重新现身，笑吟吟的看着你，从你手中轻轻拿过那书籍。

8250467.en: Well done! You've helped me settle the score. Here are some little treasures—just a token of my appreciation. Take them. I have urgent matters to attend to, so I'll be going now.
8250467.ch: 了不起，你替姐姐出了口气，这些小宝贝，算是小小心意，请你收下。姐姐还要要事，先走了。

8250468.en: I thought you would stand up for me in my time of need, but I see I was mistaken. Well, I won't press the matter. I should go now—my pursuers will catch up soon enough.
8250468.ch: 原想孤立无援之际，你会替姐姐出头的，却未料是这样的结果。姐姐也不强求了，先行一步，不然那些追杀我的人啊，就要跟上了。

8250469.en: {name|B} maintains a graceful smile, though she cannot fully hide her disappointment. With a slight turn, she glides away into the distance.
8250469.ch: {name|B}语笑嫣然，但情态之中难掩其中失望之意，她稍一转身，人已翩然去得远了。

8250470.en: Have you heard? Everyone's received this mysterious bounty to capture that witch, the very same one trapped in that book!
8250470.ch: 我听说大伙接到神秘悬赏，前往抓拿那妖妇。呐就是那个困在书中的妖妇！

8250471.en: Shall we go after her too? This mysterious bounty is a golden opportunity!
8250471.ch: 我们也去吧？接到神秘悬赏可是天赐的良机！

8250472.en: Heh, let's go! I probably couldn't handle it alone.
8250472.ch: 嘿嘿，走！只有我一个的话，指不定应付不过来。

8250473.en: {name|B} sits casually on a stone, gazing at the distant mountains. Something appears to be troubling her mind.
8250473.ch: 只见{name|B}闲坐石上，遥望远山，似乎正为什么而烦恼。

8250474.en: Oh my, coming to see me of your own accord? Aren't you afraid I might scheme against you or set you up, causing you needless trouble?
8250474.ch: 呦，今天竟主动来找姐姐吗？不怕姐姐算计你，给你下套，平白给你添些麻烦？

8250475.en: Impressive how you face challenges head-on. But aren't you afraid I might use you to commit evil deeds? That would make you my accomplice.
8250475.ch: 直面困难，了不起。但你就不怕我借你之手，去做恶事吗？这样一来，你就成了帮凶了。

8250476.en: How interesting. I do love a righteous soul.
8250476.ch: 有意思，姐姐就喜欢正义之士。

8250477.en: Sigh. While grand endeavors require bold action, matters of principle, no matter how small, also deserve careful consideration.
8250477.ch: 唉，大事固然要在大处着力，但若涉及原则，即使小处也需斟酌一二。

8250478.en: Which is it? Are you afraid of making more enemies, or do you fear becoming my blade, unwittingly committing evil deeds?
8250478.ch: 你是怕仇人变多了，还是害怕成了姐姐手中之刀，不知不觉间行了恶事？

8250479.en: Enough of that. I am truly backed into a corner. If I don't find more books soon, they'll seize everything, and I'll face endless imprisonment once again. If I fail this time... I fear there will be no coming back.
8250479.ch: 罢了，不说那些。其实姐姐也是迫于无奈的，眼下我再不多找几本书籍，恐怕就会被人一举拿走，再受那无穷无尽的牢狱之灾。这次再失手，恐怕就永无翻身之日了。

8250480.en: Still, I am deeply moved. After years of confinement, I'd grown detached from everything... Never did I imagine I'd find someone to share my heart with.
8250480.ch: 不过，姐姐很感动，姐姐长年受困，早对这世上的事看淡了，只没想还能找到个促膝长谈的挚友。

8250481.en: {name|B} gazes at you with tender affection, her eyes glistening with emotion. She seems ready to pull you into an embrace.
8250481.ch: {name|B}满脸温柔的看着你，她此时眼波盈盈，似乎想将你一把拥入怀中。

8250482.en: So... you wouldn't mind helping me take care of those worthless pests, would you?
8250482.ch: 所以，其实你不介意帮助姐姐处理那些杂碎的喽？

8250483.en: That's more like it. Look—they're here!
8250483.ch: 这就对了，你看，他们来了！

8250484.en: Where's that witch? The signal clearly pointed here—where is she? You must be that woman's lapdog!
8250484.ch: 那妖妇呢？方位指示明明是这边，怎么不见人？你就是那妖妇的走狗是吧？

8250485.en: We'll force you to reveal that witch's location today. Attack!
8250485.ch: 今日一定要逼问出那妖妇的位置。动手！

8250486.en: Just as they begin to cast their spells, thunder roars overhead. A thousand streaks of lightning descend upon the pair, weaving and interlocking around them in a deadly dance. Their protective Qi barriers crackle and spark under the assault.
8250486.ch: 他们正要施法，不想天空响起一阵轰隆声，千道雷光瞬间落在二人周身，彼此交缠环环交错，滋得他二人护体灵气噼啪作响。

8250487.en: Ha! A simple trick was all it took to catch two bumbling fools. I have greater plans for these two, so I'll let them live... for now!
8250487.ch: 呵呵，略施小计便逮住了两只迷路的小笨贼。他们二人我还有大用，今日还得放他们走！

8250488.en: Oh my, does this mean I've found you two more admirers? *giggles* Meeting me must be your de-sti-ny—!
8250488.ch: 哎呀，那么说，我又为你添得两名“心上人”了？咯咯，遇到我，原是你福~缘~深~厚~呢
